title: Amazon & E-Commerce Marketing Strategist
description:
Reports To: Owner

Department: Amazon / E-Commerce / Marketing

Status: Full-Time

Schedule: Monday–Friday. Fixed PST hours strongly preferred (8:00 AM–4:00 PM or 9:00 AM–5:00 PM PST); 

candidates offering substantial daily overlap with PST business hours will also be considered.

Location: Remote



1. Position Summary

This is a senior, strategy-level marketing role — not an entry-level or trainee position. We are hiring someone who 

already knows how to research a target audience, position a product against competitors, and write listing and 

marketing content that converts, and who can own that work independently from day one.

The core of this role is marketing strategy and positioning: researching who a product's buyer actually is, what they're 

looking for, and how to frame a product so it wins against alternatives — then translating that thinking into listing 

copy, A+ content, and supporting marketing materials across Amazon and third-party marketplaces. Fluency with 

modern AI research and writing tools (Helium 10, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and AI imaging tools) is expected as 

part of how this work gets done efficiently — it supports the strategic and writing skill, it doesn't replace it.

The scope is expanding to include company social media — starting with LinkedIn — as a natural extension of the 

same audience-research and positioning skill set.

If you have not done audience research, competitive positioning, or marketing/listing writing before, this is not 

the role to learn on. We're looking for someone who can step in, take ownership of a product or listing, and run 

the strategy-to-execution process with minimal ramp-up.



2. Core Responsibilities



A. Marketing Strategy, Research & Positioning

• Research target audiences for each product — who the buyer is, what they're solving for, and how they evaluate 

options — and use that research to drive positioning decisions, not just describe the product.

• Conduct competitive research and analysis to identify how to position a product to win against named and 

unnamed alternatives on the market.

• Own the strategic framing for new product launches and listing rewrites: the angle, the audience, and the proof 

points, before a word of copy is written.

• Maintain and refine a repeatable research framework so positioning work is consistent and defensible across 

products.



B. Amazon & Third-Party Marketplace Listings

• Own listing creation end to end: research, positioning, listing copy, A+ content modules, and imagery, through to 

go-live.

• Build and maintain A+ content and image sets for existing products, including image optimization and content 

refresh projects.

• Extend listing presence to third-party marketplaces beyond Amazon, adapting content and positioning to each 

platform's requirements and audience.

• Own listing quality and category-placement work — resolving classification issues, closing keyword gaps, and 

running optimization passes on underperforming listings.



C. AI-Assisted Research & Content Tools

• Use Helium 10 as the core marketplace research and keyword tool for product and competitive research.

• Use AI assistants — Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity — as working tools for research synthesis, positioning 

exploration, and content drafting.

• Use AI or standard imaging/design tools to produce and optimize listing and A+ imagery.

• These tools support the underlying research, writing, and positioning skill — they are not a substitute for it.



D. Graphic Designer Coordination & Project Completion

• Serve as the primary coordination point with the graphic designer on all listing and A+ imagery — briefing the 

designer, setting expectations, and tracking delivery through to final, published assets.

• Own the completion of design-dependent listing projects end to end: confirm briefs are clear, review drafts against 

the positioning and audience research behind the listing, give focused revision feedback, and drive the project to 

done rather than leaving it open-ended.

• Proactively flag delivery timing risks or unclear briefs before they stall a listing launch.



E. Social Media & Content Strategy (Expanding Scope)

• Own the company's LinkedIn presence as the first phase of a broader social media function: content calendar, post 

drafting, and voice/brand consistency with marketplace listings.

• Apply the same audience-research and positioning approach used for listings to social content.

• Scope future expansion into additional social channels as the LinkedIn function matures, subject to approval.



F. Coordination & Documentation

• Route technical accuracy and specification questions to the relevant technical/product resource and confirm 

resolution before content goes live.

• Review marketplace customer feedback and advertising-related items relevant to listing content, and turn them 

into clear next steps.

• Maintain documentation tied to listings, such as standardized technical data sheet templates, in partnership with 

technical staff.



3. Authority & Decision Boundaries

This role MAY:

• Independently research, position, and draft listing and marketing content within brand guidelines.

• Select and use AI and research tools (Helium 10, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, imaging tools) to execute the work.

• Draft and post social content within an approved content strategy.

• Recommend tool subscriptions or upgrades with cost/benefit rationale for approval.

• Flag stalled projects, at-risk deadlines, or content/tool issues directly to leadership.



This role MAY NOT (without approval):

• Finalize brand voice, positioning, or creative direction on major launches or storefront redesigns.

• Approve advertising budgets, bidding, or campaign strategy.

• Commit to new paid tool subscriptions or vendor/contractor arrangements.

• Publish new social channels beyond the approved scope (currently LinkedIn) without sign-off.

• Approve refunds, returns, or customer concessions outside written policy.

When in doubt, escalate. Speed and clarity of escalation is valued over independent judgment on gray-area items.



4. Qualifications

This is a senior hire. We are not looking to train someone in audience research, positioning, or marketing 

writing from scratch — you should already do this well and be able to demonstrate it.

Required

• Fluent, native-level or near-native-level English, written and spoken. This is non-negotiable — the role is built on 

writing and positioning, and there is no room for translation gaps.

• Demonstrated, hands-on experience researching target audiences and positioning products or services against 

competitors — you can show work, not just describe the concept.

• Several years of hands-on experience writing and optimizing e-commerce marketplace listings (titles, bullets, A+ 

content) that you can point to and discuss.

• Working knowledge of Helium 10 or a comparable marketplace research/keyword tool.

• Practical, hands-on fluency with AI assistants for research and writing work — specifically Claude, Gemini, and 

Perplexity — and at least one AI or standard imaging/design tool for listing graphics.

• Comfortable owning a product or listing from research through published content with minimal oversight.

Preferred

• Prior experience managing a brand's LinkedIn or other social media presence.

• Experience listing on third-party marketplaces beyond Amazon.

• Exposure to industrial or B2B product categories.

• Solid understanding of SEO as it applies to marketplace listings and social content.



5. Success Metrics (First 90 Days)

• Independently research, position, and publish at least one new or rewritten listing with minimal direction.

• A clean, working coordination process with the graphic designer — clear briefs, tracked delivery, no listing 

project stalled waiting on unclear direction.

• A documented AI-assisted research and writing workflow in place and usable by others on the team.

• Helium 10 keyword and competitive research driving at least one measurable listing improvement (ranking, 

conversion, or category placement).

• Company LinkedIn presence launched with a documented content strategy and a regular posting cadence.

• Demonstrated ability to own listing and content decisions day-to-day without close oversight.



6. Reporting & Working Relationships

Reports To Owner

Primary Coordination Graphic Designer — daily/weekly coordination on listing 

and A+ imagery

Technical/Product Accuracy Technical/Product Specialist — chemistry, specs, TDS 

accuracy

Advertising & SEO Amazon Advertising & SEO Manager — coordination on 

keyword/SEO-related items



7. Schedule Requirements

• Full-time, Monday–Friday.

• Fixed PST schedule preferred: 8:00 AM–4:00 PM PST or 9:00 AM–5:00 PM PST.

• Candidates unable to commit to a fixed PST schedule may still be considered if they can offer substantial daily 

overlap with PST business hours.



8. Compensation

• Competitive rate based on experience.

• Long-term, stable engagement with a defined growth path as the social media function expands.



Please send over your resume. Thanks

title: Graphic Designer
description:
We are a U.S.-based B2B industrial supply business looking for a graphic designer to support our ongoing e-commerce, marketing, and product documentation work.



1. Position Summary

We need a graphic designer who can produce clean, industrial-style visual assets across multiple formats — enhanced product content, e-commerce listing imagery, website imagery, packaging, labels, infographics, and product documentation.

Think 3M. Think Grainger. Think Uline. That is the visual register we work in: B2B industrial, utilitarian, spec-driven, durable-looking, function-first. Clean typography, technical illustration, performance claims front and center. This is not consumer retail — it is industrial supply.

That said, the design sensibility must be contemporary, not dated. We want modern industrial — the way the best B2B brands look today, not how a 1990s parts catalog looked. Visuals should feel current and relevant to today's working professionals — millennials and Gen X buyers in their 30s through 50s who are the actual decision-makers in industrial purchasing.

This is not a role for designers whose strongest work is lifestyle, beauty, fashion, wedding, or consumer-brand aesthetics. If your portfolio is built around pastels, soft-lifestyle photography, or "girly" branding, this is not your fit.

The right candidate is equally comfortable producing an enhanced content banner for an e-commerce listing and laying out a print-ready box label with regulatory text, lot numbers, and barcode placement.



2. Scope of Work

The designer will produce visual assets including:

Enhanced product content and e-commerce listing imagery (product detail page modules, brand store imagery, hero banners)

Website images and banners

Product labels and box label design (print-ready, with regulatory and barcode placement)

Box and packaging design

Infographics for product features, specifications, and application guides

Flyers, brochures, and sell sheets (digital and print)

Safety Data Sheet (SDS) formatting and layout support

Other ad-hoc graphic design work as needed



3. Required Skills & Experience

Proven portfolio of industrial, B2B, MRO, hardware, or technical product design — please include examples

Fluent in English — speaking, listening, and writing. You must be able to communicate effectively with us in real time, understand verbal direction clearly, and respond promptly in writing. This is non-negotiable.

A real creative streak and a contemporary design sensibility. Your work should look current and modern — industrial, but not dated. We need someone who brings ideas to the table, not someone who only applies templates. Designs must resonate with today's working-age buyers (roughly 30s through 50s), not feel like a relic from a previous generation.

Fluent with enhanced product content and e-commerce listing imagery requirements across major marketplaces (module structures, image specs, dimensions, file formats)

Experience designing print-ready files (labels, packaging, brochures) with attention to bleed, color profiles, and dieline accuracy

Strong typography and layout skills for dense, information-heavy content (specs, instructions, regulatory text)

Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) or equivalent professional tools

Ability to follow brand guidelines and maintain visual consistency across assets



To apply, please send over your resume and portfolio.

title: Nutra VSL/Meta Ads Video Editor – AI-Native
description:
ABOUT US



We are a marketing agency running paid campaigns on Meta and YouTube every single day. We need a video editor who already knows this world - someone who has cut UGC raw footage into ads that actually perform, not just pretty videos.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



1. A video editor who already lives in this world. You should have cut VSLs and Meta ad creatives for other advertisers before.

2. You know what a hook has to do in the first three seconds.

3. You know how to build a lead that survives the scroll, and why the same VSL needs ten different openers.

4. You know how to keep a weight loss or blood sugar angle inside Meta's policy lines instead of getting the account slapped.



YOU WORK AI-FIRST



Just as important as your editing: you build with AI, not around it.



1. You can generate b-roll, avatars, voiceovers and full ad variants, rather than only assembling footage someone hands you.

2. Runway, Kling, Veo, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Midjourney or Flux, Topaz — whatever gets the shot without a shoot.



HOW WE WORK



1. We iterate constantly. Expect to ship batches of hook and angle variations every week, take winning concepts and spin them out in ten directions, and work directly off performance data rather than guesswork.

2. If you've only edited YouTube content or corporate video, this isn't your role.

3. If you've made nutra ads profitable for someone else, it is.





TO APPLY



1. Send links to nutra or direct-response VSLs and Meta ads you personally cut — the offers, and any performance numbers you're allowed to share.

2. Tell us which AI tools you use daily and what you've generated with them.

3. Start your message with the word WEIGHTLOSS so we know you read this.



*Applications without a portfolio will be deleted unread.*

title: Dispatch & Customer Service Coordinator (Inbound/Outbound)
description:
We are hiring a calm, dependable customer-service professional to be the front line for a growing U.S.-based home-services business. You will answer and place calls, keep customers informed, coordinate schedules with technicians, and make every interaction feel clear and cared for.



This is not a back-office data-entry role. Clear, understandable spoken English, strong listening, and sound customer judgment are the priority.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN

• Answer inbound customer calls, identify the customer’s need, capture accurate details, and guide the conversation to a clear next step.

• Make outbound calls and messages to confirm appointments, update customers on technician arrival windows, reschedule when needed, and close the loop on open issues.

• Coordinate daily schedules with technicians and the office; recognize urgent situations, communicate changes quickly, and protect the customer experience.

• Keep job notes, customer records, appointment details, and follow-up commitments accurate in our dispatch/CRM tools.

• Handle upset or anxious customers with empathy, ownership, and practical judgment—without making promises you cannot keep.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SETUP

• At least 12 months of demonstrated voice-based customer service, dispatch, appointment-setting, scheduling, or coordination work supporting U.S. or other international customers.

• Fluent, clear, and understandable spoken English. We care about customer comprehension, active listening, tone, and judgment—not a particular accent.

• Strong written English and careful attention to names, dates, addresses, service details, and commitments.

• Ability to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours. This full-time role is scheduled for 50 hours per week; reliable availability during our core Eastern Time coverage is essential. You must also have reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, and a professional headset.

• Confidence using web-based software, calendars, CRMs, phone systems, and multi-channel customer communication.



Home-services, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or similar field-service experience is preferred, but a proven record in a fast-moving customer coordination role matters most.



COMPENSATION & GROWTH

Competitive compensation will reflect demonstrated relevant experience, communication skill, reliability, and availability. Please include your desired monthly compensation and earliest available start date.



This is a long-term role for someone who wants to become deeply trusted in customer operations—not simply answer calls. Strong performers can grow into senior dispatch, customer-success, quality, and operations-coordination responsibilities.



HOW TO APPLY — STEP 1 IS AN AUDIO LINK

We use this first step because the role is customer-facing by phone. Begin your written application with this exact first line: “I can cover U.S. Eastern Time.” Use this subject line: “DISPATCH COORDINATOR — [your name].” Use exactly six Apply Points. Then complete the audio step below. Please do not send a generic “interested” message.



Record a 60–90 second audio response:

Scenario: A customer calls because their technician is running late. They are frustrated and need an update. Leave the phone response you would give. Introduce yourself, acknowledge the concern, give a clear update without making promises you cannot keep, explain the next step, and close professionally.



Upload the recording as an MP3 or M4A to your own Google Drive. Set the individual file to “Anyone with the link” ? “Viewer,” then send the file link in your OnlineJobs.ph application. Please state your name and OnlineJobs.ph profile name at the beginning. Do not send a folder link or a link that requires access.



Also include 2–4 sentences about your most relevant prior role: the customers you supported, approximate daily call/message volume, and the scheduling or customer issues you handled.



Your response may be reviewed using a consistent, job-related communication rubric with AI assistance and by our hiring team; people make all hiring decisions. Candidates who complete Step 1 may be invited to a short written customer scenario and live role-play.

HOW TO APPLY

 with the subject line "Legal Tech Project Manager Application — [Your Name]" and include:

6. Maintain and troubleshoot systems inside law firms post-implementation

mbers supporting the same client accounts

Package What It Includes Price

• Respond to all HubSpot tasks and reminders on the same day they are assigned.



Team Collaboration

• Attend all tea
etings and training sessions led by the Sales Manager.

• Share successful scripts, objection handling techniques, and call insights with the team.

• Communicate blockers, lead quality issues, or process problems to the Sales Manager immediately — no surprises.



QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• Minimum 1 year of outbound sales or telemarketing experience — credit repair, mortgage, insurance, or financial services preferred.

• Excellent spoken English — confident, clear, and professional on the phone with US consumers.

• Strong objection handling skills — you know how to handle "I can't afford it," "I've tried this before," and "Let me think about it."

• Self-motivated and results-driven — you track your own numbers and push yourself to hit targets.

• Reliable internet connection minimum 25 Mbps, dedicated workspace, headset, and webcam.

• Available to work US Eastern Time hours Monday through Friday.



Preferred

• Familiarity with Go To phone system or similar VoIP platforms.

• Experience with
 or Google lead ad campaigns and how to qualify inbound leads quickly.

HubSpot CRM updated same day 100% of calls logged daily

Package Sold Sale Price Your Commission

This person will help create greater accountability, organization, and redundancy throughout the company. They will make sure recurring responsibilities are completed, important projects continue moving, and leadership has accurate information when decisions need to be made.

mbers have proper systems access and two-factor authentication.

mbers are unavailable.

mber.

Leadership Meetings and Company Follow-Through

- Distribute action items and follow up with responsible tea
mbers.

Executive Support for the Founder

A major part of this role will be creating leverage for John, the Founder and CEO.

Responsibilities will include:

- Reviewing and managing John’s
 account throughout the workday.

- Routing
s and requests to the appropriate departments or tea
mbers.

title: Senior Criminal Defense Paralegal / Attorney Support Specialist
description:
Havenridge Incorporated is seeking an experienced Senior Criminal Defense Paralegal / Attorney Support Specialist to support a busy U.S. criminal defense practice.



This is not an entry-level Legal Assistant or general Virtual Assistant position.



We are specifically looking for an experienced criminal-defense professional who is highly organized, assertive, proactive, deadline-driven, and capable of taking ownership of an attorney’s daily case workflow.



The ideal candidate is the person who notices that something is missing before the attorney asks about it, recognizes when a court date or deadline does not look right, follows outstanding matters until they are actually resolved, and is comfortable working independently in an environment where priorities can change quickly.



Professional U.S. Criminal Defense experience and professional Clio experience are required.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Manage the attorney’s daily case schedule and ensure the attorney knows what matters require attention each day

• Maintain and manage attorney calendars in Clio and Google Calendar

• Track court appearances, hearings, filing deadlines, client appointments, and case-related deadlines

• Review criminal matters regularly to determine what is outstanding and what needs to happen next

• Review court websites and dockets for case updates, hearings, filings, and changes

• Compare court information against internal calendars and case records and identify discrepancies

• Create, update, and maintain matters within Clio Manage

• Maintain detailed and accurate case notes

• Prepare, organize, upload, name, and maintain legal documents and case files

• Assist with criminal pleadings, motions, filings, discovery, exhibits, correspondence, and other case-related documents

• Coordinate electronic filing and service when required

• Track discovery and outstanding documents

• Communicate directly with clients regarding court dates, appointments, required documents, reminders, and case-related information within the scope of the position

• Communicate professionally with courts, prosecutors’ offices, opposing counsel, vendors, and other parties when required

• Coordinate meetings, Zoom appearances, consultations, and attorney appointments

• Follow up on incomplete assignments without waiting to be reminded

• Identify urgent issues and escalate them immediately

• Maintain an accurate daily understanding of where assigned criminal matters stand

• Assist the attorney with preparation for hearings and other court proceedings

• Document completed work so another tea
mber can immediately determine what occurred and what remains outstanding



THIS POSITION REQUIRES OWNERSHIP



We are not looking for someone who waits for a daily checklist and stops working when the checklist is complete.



We need someone who can look at a criminal case, the attorney’s calendar, the court docket, existing notes, outstanding tasks, and upcoming deadlines and recognize what requires attention.



You should be comfortable asking questions when instructions conflict, identifying potential problems, following up when someone has not responded, and bringing issues to the attorney’s attention before they become emergencies.



Completing a task means ensuring the objective was accomplished—not simply sending an
 and considering the matter finished.



MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS



• Substantial professional experience supporting a U.S. Criminal Defense practice

• Strong understanding of criminal-defense case workflow and terminology

• Professional experience using Clio Manage

• Experience managing attorney calendars and court deadlines

• Experience reviewing court dockets or court websites

• Experience communicating directly with U.S. legal clients

• Experience preparing and organizing criminal case documents

• Strong written and spoken English

• Exceptional organizational skills

• Excellent attention to detail

• Strong follow-through

• Ability to prioritize urgent matters without constant direction

• Ability to independently manage multiple active matters

• Ability to recognize when information is missing or inconsistent

• Comfortable working directly with attorneys in a fast-moving environment

• Reliable computer, high-speed internet, and professional remote workspace

• Availability during required U.S. Central Time business hours



DO NOT APPLY IF:



• You have never professionally worked in U.S. Criminal Defense

• Your legal experience is primarily intake, customer service, or general administrative support

• You have never independently tracked court dates or legal deadlines

• You have never professionally used Clio Manage

• Your Clio experience comes only from tutorials, courses, certifications, or self-study

• You need continuous instructions to determine what to work on next

• You are uncomfortable identifying errors or questioning conflicting information

• You routinely require reminders to follow up on unfinished work

• You are looking for an entry-level opportunity to learn criminal law



HIRING & EVALUATION PROCESS



Candidates will be questioned specifically about their U.S. Criminal Defense experience. Please answer accurately. We would rather hear that you have not performed a particular task than have a candidate exaggerate their experience to obtain the position.



Candidates who advance will participate in a paid practical training and evaluation period.



The evaluation may include reviewing criminal matters, identifying outstanding issues, reviewing court information, calendaring, prioritizing assignments, organizing case information, following written instructions, and demonstrating how you would manage an attorney’s daily workflow.



We are evaluating more than whether you can complete individual tasks. We are evaluating judgment, ownership, accuracy, organization, criminal-law knowledge, follow-through, and the ability to recognize what needs attention without being continuously directed.

description:
# AI Video Content Creator – Google Flow, HeyGen & ElevenLabs



**Type of Work:** Part-Time, long-term

**Hours:** Approximately 20 hours per week initially

**Schedule:** Flexible, with consistent production deadlines

**Compensation:** $3 USD per approved video, plus performance and volume bonuses



## About the Role



We are a growing content media agency that creates short-form affiliate videos for products.



We are looking for a reliable and creative AI Video Content Creator who can use generative AI tools to produce engaging TikTok, Instagram Reel, and
 Reel content.



Our videos may include AI-generated characters, talking avatars, voiceovers, product scenes, image-to-video generations, AI B-roll, and other synthetic media.



We currently use tools such as:



* Google Flow

* Google Veo

* HeyGen

* ElevenLabs

* CapCut or similar editing software

* Additional AI video, image, voice, and automation platforms



We will teach you our current production process, including the prompts, templates, tools, examples, and standard operating procedures we use.



Previous experience with these tools is strongly preferred, but it is not required if you are technically capable, learn quickly, and can follow detailed instructions.



## Your Responsibilities



* Create short-form AI videos for affiliate campaigns.

* Generate AI characters, scenes, product demonstrations, B-roll, and other visual assets.

* Create realistic AI voiceovers using tools such as ElevenLabs.

* Create talking-character or lip-synced videos using tools such as HeyGen.

* Use Google Flow, Veo, and similar platforms to generate video clips.

* Write and improve prompts based on our instructions and reference examples.

* Maintain character, clothing, environment, and visual consistency across generations.

* Combine generated assets into polished vertical videos.

* Add captions, sound effects, music, transitions, hooks, and on-screen text.

* Follow scripts, shot lists, prompts, templates, and reference videos.

* Identify generation errors such as unnatural movements, distorted hands, incorrect products, inconsistent characters, or poor lip-sync.

* Regenerate or correct assets when the quality does not meet our standards.

* Organize generated files, project files, prompts, and final exports.

* Track assigned and completed videos inside our content management system.

* Make reasonable revisions based on feedback.

* Meet agreed daily and weekly production targets.



You will not normally be responsible for posting the videos. Your primary responsibility will be creating and delivering finished content.



## Requirements



* Strong interest in AI content creation and generative media.

* Experience with at least one AI image, video, avatar, or voice-generation platform.

* Basic short-form video-editing ability using CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar software.

* Good written English and the ability to understand English scripts.

* Ability to write, test, and improve AI prompts.

* Strong attention to visual details and continuity.

* Ability to recognize when an AI generation looks unnatural or unusable.

* Ability to follow a repeatable production process.

* Reliable computer and internet connection.

* Consistent communication and ability to meet deadlines.

* Willingness to receive feedback and improve quickly.



## Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a strong advantage:



* Google Flow or Google Veo

* HeyGen

* ElevenLabs

* AI image-generation platforms

* Image-to-video generation

* AI avatars and talking characters

* Character-consistency workflows

* AI voice cloning or text-to-speech

* Affiliate content

* UGC-style product advertisements

* Viral hooks and short-form storytelling

* CapCut or Adobe Premiere Pro

* Prompt engineering

* E-commerce or direct-response advertising



You do not need experience with every platform listed. We care more about your ability to learn tools quickly, follow our systems, and consistently produce high-quality content.



## Compensation



Compensation ranges from **$3 USD per approved video**, depending on the complexity of the assignment.



Compensation may also include:



* Volume bonuses

* Reliability bonuses

* Performance bonuses

* Rate increases for consistently strong work

* Additional responsibilities for top-performing tea
mbers



Access to the AI tools required for our production process will be provided or arranged by the company.



One reasonable revision is normally included. Additional revisions caused by changed instructions may be compensated separately. Corrections required because the original instructions were not followed are not considered additional paid revisions.



## Training



We will provide training on:



* Our content strategy

* Our AI production workflow

* Prompt structures

* Character and scene creation

* Voice-generation settings

* Video-generation settings

* File organization

* Quality-control standards

* Editing templates

* Examples of successful videos

* Common AI-generation mistakes to avoid



You should be comfortable learning new software because the AI content-creation industry changes quickly and we may introduce additional tools over time.



## Paid Test Assignment



Shortlisted applicants will receive a small paid test assignment.



We may provide:



* A script

* A reference video

* Character images

* Product information

* Prompt examples

* A production brief

* Access to the required tools



The test will evaluate:



* Ability to follow instructions

* AI-generation quality

* Prompt-writing ability

* Character and visual consistency

* Video pacing and editing

* Attention to detail

* Communication

* File organization

* Turnaround time

* Ability to apply feedback



The paid test does not guarantee a permanent position.



## How to Apply



Begin your application with the words **“AI VIDEO CREATOR”** so we know you read the full job description.



Include the following:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Links to 2–4 AI-generated videos or short-form videos you personally created.

3. A clear explanation of what you used to create those videos.

4. A list of the AI tools you have used.

5. Your experience with Google Flow, Veo, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, AI avatars, or AI voice-generation tools.

6. Your experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, or other editing software.

7. An example of a difficult AI-generation problem you encountered and how you solved it.

8. How long you estimate it would take you to create a 60–120 -second AI video using a provided workflow.

9. How many videos you could realistically complete per day.

10. Your current work availability.

11. Your computer specifications and internet connection.



Please do not send a generic application. Applicants who do not answer the questions above will not be considered.



We are looking for someone dependable, detail-oriented, technically capable, and interested in building a long-term working relationship with a growing AI content team.

title: Sales Data & Reporting Auditor
description:
Why This Role Exists



Zion currently manages ~15 sales reps across multiple offers while also running recruiting, interviews, call reviews, and data integrity. Data integrity is the piece with the lowest skill ceiling and the highest time cost.



Per Josh's Framework 6 (Pipeline Management), this is a named, separate seat for a reason:



Josh once had sales managers audit the CRM daily — chasing reps for missed forms, unmarked show-ups, blank fields. It completely destroyed his capacity model for sales management. The fix was a dedicated CRM Admin owning the tech and data side, so managers spend 30 minutes in the CRM and know everything is where it's supposed to be.



The purpose of this role is to protect the sales manager's capacity. Every hour it buys back gets redeployed into call reviews, rep coaching, and client acquisition — the things that actually move revenue.



The Two Audit Paths



Every issue this person finds falls into one of two buckets. They are handled differently. This distinction is the entire job.



Path 1 — Data Accuracy ? the Auditor fixes it



Data that is wrong or missing because of a system gap, not a rep behavior problem.

- Booked call on the calendar with no lead source attribution.

-Lead in CRM with no meeting date attached.

-Duplicate leads or duplicate calendar events

-Calendar event missing setter initials

-Disposition logged but revenue field blank

-Timezone or date errors on booked calls



Action: fix it directly, log it in the daily report as a count.



Path 2 — Rep Non-Compliance ? the Auditor tags, never cleans

-Data that is wrong because a rep didn't do their job.

-Call happened, no disposition logged

-Show / no-show never marked

-Post-call form not completed

-Lead marked lost with no attempt history

-Deal closed with no payment terms entered

-

Action: tag the rep, create the task, escalate in the daily report.  Do not fix it for them.



Non-negotiable, per Josh: "CRM admins audit — they don't clean. Cleaners create lazy reps."



The 
nt reps learn someone downstream cleans up after them, compliance collapses permanently and the data problem becomes structural. The Auditor's job on Path 2 is to make non-compliance visible, not invisible.



Daily Responsibilities



Morning — booked call audit (start of day)Pull every call on the calendar for the current day and produce:



1. Total booked calls today, by closer

2. Source attribution on every booked call — Ads (self-booked) / Phone Setter / DM Setter / Triage / Reschedule / Referral

3. Setter attribution by initials on every setter-sourced call

4. Confirmation status per the calendar color convention:

          Unmarked = unconfirmed

          Red = no answer

          Yellow = text confirmation received

          Light green = same-day confirmation received

5. Exception list — every call with no confirmation touch at all. This is the highest-value output of the morning report. Every unconfirmed call is a booked call at risk, and it is actionable before the call, not after.



End of day — outcome audit

1. Live calls (showed) vs. booked calls, by closer and by setter.

2. Show rate for the day, and rolling 7-day

3. No-shows and cancellations, with reschedule status: rescheduled / attempted, not reached / no attempt made

4. "No attempt made" list — every no-show nobody has touched. Escalate by name.

5. Missing dispositions — every call with no outcome logged, tagged to the rep.

6. Cash collected logged against calls, where applicable



Weekly — rollup

1. Show rate by setter, trended

2. Booked calls by source, trended — which channel is actually producing.

3. Data-accuracy issue counts by type, trended (are the same issues recurring?).

4. Rep non-compliance counts, by rep name



Metrics This Role Owns



Metrics & Definition:



Booked calls / day = Total on calendar, by closer

Source attribution % = % of booked calls with a source recorded. Target: 100%

Confirmation coverage = % of tomorrow's calls with a confirmation touch logged

Live calls / day = Calls that showed

Show rate = Live ÷ booked, daily and rolling 7-day

Reschedule capture rate = % of no-shows with a documented reschedule attempt

Disposition compliance = % of completed calls with an outcome logged

Data accuracy issues = Count found, count fixed, by category



Show rate belongs to the setter and confirmation layer. It is never a closer metric. This role reports it against setters, not closers.



Explicitly NOT This Role

- Not a sales role. 

- No dialing, no setting, no closing, no prospect contact.

- Not a call reviewer. Call quality grading stays with Zion.

- Not a coach. They report data on reps. They never give reps feedback or direction.

- Not a cleaner for rep non-compliance. See Path 2 above.

- Not the person who d
 what the numbers mean. They report accurately and flag anomalies. Interpretation and action are Zion's.



Required Skills:

-Must have



- High-volume, detail-heavy data work with near-zero error tolerance

- CRM competence — Close CRM strongly preferred; HubSpot / Salesforce / GHL acceptable

- Google Sheets: pivot tables, lookups, conditional formatting

- Google Calendar

- Slack

- Written English clear enough to write a report a manager reads in 60 seconds

Overlap with US Eastern business hours



Nice to have

- Zapier or Make

- Experience inside a sales team (understands what a booked call, show rate, and disposition actually are)

- Prior audit or QA role



Disqualifying

- Needs to be told the same thing twice

- Reports numbers without flagging when a number looks wrong



Reporting Cadence



When - What - Where



Daily, by 9:00 AM ET - Morning booked-call audit + unconfirmed exception list - Slack

Daily, within 30 min of last call - EOD outcome audit + no-attempt list - Slack

Weekly, Monday AM - Rolling rollup - Slack + Sheet



Format requirement: every report is scannable in under 60 seconds. Number first, exception list second, everything else omitted. Nobody reads a wall of data — the exception list is the product.



30-Day Ramp



Week 1 — observe and document



Shadow the current manual process. Document it as they learn it — that document becomes the role's SOP and its first deliverable.



Week 2 — morning report only



Own the morning booked-call audit. Zion verifies against source data daily. Accuracy before scope.



Week 3 — add EOD report



Both daily reports running. Auditor begins flagging Path 1 data-accuracy issues and fixing them.



Week 4 — full scope



Weekly rollup added. Path 2 rep tagging goes live. Zion spot-checks weekly instead of daily.



Ramp gate: the role is not considered ramped until Zion has spot-checked a full week of reports against source data and found zero discrepancies. Wrong data is worse than no data — it produces confidently wrong decisions.



Documentation Requirement



Every process this person runs gets documented as they run it, not after. By day 30 there should be a complete SOP covering: where each number is pulled from, how each is calculated, the report template, and the escalation path for each issue type.



Per Josh: document while doing, not before delegating. If this person leaves, the replacement should be productive in a week off the SOP alone. The right sequence: hire this person to run it manually and document the exact logic while doing it. That documentation becomes the automation spec. Once the reports are automated, the role shifts from producing the data to auditing it — which is the seat Josh actually describes, and it scales.



Hire for the manual work. Scope the job so it produces the automation.



How to Apply

To be considered for this role, you must include the word "Sesquipedalian" in your
 subject line or within the very first sentence of your message. Applications lacking "Sesquipedalian" will automatically be skipped out.



We are reviewing applications on a rolling, fast-track basis to fill this seat immediately with the right candidate. Qualified applicants will receive prompt outreach for an initial interview.

title: Appointment Setter
description:
Appointment Setter — Group Travel (US calls, part-time)

We are a small US travel company in Chattanooga, Tennessee. We help churches, dance studios, youth sports clubs and similar community organizations put their families on a group cruise together.



We need a warm, clear-speaking appointment setter to call these organizations from a list we provide and book a short intro call on our calendar.



You are not selling anything. You cannot and must not quote prices or describe what a cruise includes — that is a legal line in our industry, not a preference. Your entire job is to reach the right person, deliver a short friendly hook, and book a 15-minute call with Stephen.



What you will do

- Call churches, dance and gymnastics studios, and youth sports clubs across the southeastern US during their business hours, using a script we provide.

- Get past a receptionist politely and find the person who organizes trips.

- Book interested people directly onto our calendar while you have them on the phone.

- Log every call outcome in our system — one click, seven options, no spreadsheets.

- Honor a do-not-call request immediately and permanently, every single time.



What you will use

We provide the phone system. You dial from a browser — no phone line, no personal number, and your own number is never shown.



All calls are recorded and transcribed. We use them to improve the script and to coach. If that is not something you are comfortable with, this is not the right role.



You will need: Google Chrome, a wired headset with a microphone, a quiet room, and reliable internet.



You are a great fit if

- Your spoken English is clear, warm and natural to a US listener. This matters more than anything else on this list. You will be calling church offices and small studios in small towns. People need to feel comfortable in the first five seconds.

- You have done B2B cold calling or appointment setting before, and you can talk about it.

- You are comfortable being friendly to a receptionist rather than trying to get around them. At a church, the person who answers the phone usually knows exactly who you need.

- You follow a script exactly and do not improvise. When someone asks "how much does it cost?", the answer is always to hand it to Stephen. Getting creative here is the one mistake that ends the job.

- You stay upbeat after a lot of "no." A good day here is one booked meeting. That is normal and expected, not failure.

- You can work at least 3 hours a day inside 9:00am–6:00pm US Eastern. Churches answer in the morning, studios and sports clubs answer late afternoon, so some flexibility across the day is genuinely useful. Tell us your timezone and your realistic hours.



Compensation:

- $5 per hour base.

- $5 for every meeting you book.



The split is deliberate. Booking a meeting with a wrong
 address helps nobody, so you are paid more when the person actually shows up.



To apply, do all four. We skip applications that miss any of them.

1. Start your reply with the word SHORELINE so we know you read this.

2. In three sentences, describe a calling campaign you have run and one real result you got.

3. A prospect asks you: "Okay, how much would this cost us?" Write the exact words you would say back. (There is a right answer and it is not a number.)

4. Include a link to a 60-second voice recording — Vocaroo, Google Drive, anything — of you reading this in your natural phone voice:



"Hi, is this the church office? Great. My name is Alex, I'm calling on behalf of Stephen OLeary at Best Life Destinations here in Chattanooga. We work with churches that travel together — retreats, fellowship trips, senior adult trips, that kind of thing. Who handles trips like that for you?"



We read every application that follows these four steps. Thank you.

Compensation may also include:



* Volume bonuses

* Reliability bonuses

* Performance bonuses

* Rate increases for consistently strong work

* Additional responsibilities for top-performing tea
mbers



Access to the AI tools required for our production process will be provided or arranged by the company.



One reasonable revision is normally included. Additional revisions caused by changed instructions may be compensated separately. Corrections required because the original instructions were not followed are not considered additional paid revisions.

* Voice-generation settings

* Video-generation settings

* File organization

mbers regarding estimating progress, questions, deadlines, and outstanding information.

Complete multiple estimates while maintaining accuracy and meeting established bid deadlines.

ConstructConnect

PlanSwift

On-Screen Takeoff

AutoCAD

Microsoft Excel

Strong ability to read and interpret architectural and construction documents.

Exterior construction, façade, masonry, stucco, sheet metal, siding, waterproofing, or panel-system experience is highly preferred.

Strong mathematical and analytical skills.

Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

Strong computer and technology skills.

Ability to organize and manage multiple projects and bid deadlines simultaneously.

Ability to work independently while communicating effectively with a remote team.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Ability to identify questions or discrepancies rather than making assumptions when project information is unclear.

Dependable, organized, and committed to producing accurate work.

Masonry

Stucco and EIFS

Sheet metal

Siding

Waterproofing

Construction material takeoffs

Labor estimating

title: Founding Ecommerce Lead
description:
Summary:



We are building a new direct-to-consumer apparel brand launching in Spring 2027. Backed by a team that's done it before, we're entering a category we believe has been overlooked for far too long. Customers deserve better products, a stronger brand, and a world-class experience. We’re here to raise the bar.  



This is an opportunity to join as one of our founding employees. You'll be part of a small team making key decisions, solving meaningful problems, and building the foundation of the business from pre-launch. The pace will be fast, the challenges real, and your impact impossible to miss. Every decision you make will help shape how this business grows. 



We're looking for builders. People who embrace uncertainty, move with urgency, take ownership, and are driven by the opportunity to create something exceptional. If you're excited by big challenges, meaningful responsibility, and the chance to help build a brand from the ground up, this could be a game-changing opportunity for you. 



The Role:



As our Ecommerce Lead, you'll support the day-to-day management and performance of our website, playing a key role in driving revenue growth and delivering an exceptional customer experience. This is a highly hands-on role for someone who enjoys both strategy and execution. One day, you might be reviewing sales performance, testing new Shopify apps, or optimizing the customer journey. The next, you could be writing product copy, troubleshooting a site issue, coordinating a product launch, or identifying new opportunities for growth. 



Working closely with leaders across product, creative, marketing, and technology, you'll turn ideas into execution while continually improving how customers discover, shop, and engage with our brand. You'll have meaningful ownership, broad exposure across the business, and significant influence over the future direction of the website experience. 





Job Duties & Responsibilities:



Build & Grow the Website Experience 

-Support the day-to-day management of our Shopify storefront and all of its elements. 

-Monitor sales performance and identify opportunities to improve growth. 

-Help execute promotions, product launches, and merchandising strategies. 

-Continuously improve the customer journey from homepage through checkout. 



Create Outstanding Customer Experiences 

-Ensure products, collections, pricing, and promotions are presented accurately. 

-Improve navigation, merchandising, and overall shopping experience. 

-Identify customer pain points and implement practical improvements. 

-Work closely with creative partners to bring campaigns and new launches to life. 



Use Data to Make Better Decisions 

-Track key ecommerce metrics including revenue, conversion, AOV, and customer retention. 

-Build reports that help the team understand what's working and what isn't. 

-Use customer insights to recommend improvements across the business. 

-Support experimentation through testing and continuous optimization. 



Experience, Education & Designations:



-4+ years of ecommerce experience in a direct-to-consumer (DTC) environment.  

-Proven experience managing a Shopify storefront.  

-Demonstrated success driving ecommerce growth through merchandising, conversion optimization, and customer experience improvements.  

-Experience with merchandising, promotional planning, and ecommerce trading calendars.  

-Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, operations, creative, and other business functions.  

-Experience managing external agencies and third-party partners.  

-Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth business is considered an asset. 



Knowledge, Skills & Attributes:

-Strong analytical, commercial, and financial acumen, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.  

-Proficiency with Shopify and the broader ecommerce ecosystem.  

-Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, and Looker or similar business intelligence platforms.  

-Experience using Klaviyo, Microsoft Clarity, or similar customer engagement and behavioral analytics tools.  

-Familiarity with A/B testing platforms and conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies is considered a strong asset. 



**Applicants are encouraged to submit their resume, LinkedIn profile, as well as a 1-2 minute introductory video on why they feel they could be a good fit for this position.  Thank you to everyone who applies.

title: Video Editor — AI UGC / Ecom Ads
description:
Type: Full-time, long-term

Pay: $1,000–$1,500/month retainer + leaderboard performance bonuses

Hours: ~40/week, Monday–Friday (weekends optional but encouraged)

Location: Fully remote





------------------------------------------------------------

WHAT THIS IS

------------------------------------------------------------

I'm hiring a direct response video editor to join our creative team. You'd come

in as an editor — but I do need someone who already has solid experience and a

strong skillset, not a beginner. Full-time and long-term for the right person,

not a one-off gig.





------------------------------------------------------------

ABOUT US

------------------------------------------------------------

You'll be working with a fast-growing health and wellness brand scaling hard in

the US market. We run a huge creative team that ships a high volume of paid ad

creatives every week, and we spend serious money on ads — so the work you make

actually goes out and gets tested at scale. You'll see real numbers on your

edits, not just upload and forget.





------------------------------------------------------------

WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

------------------------------------------------------------

A direct response editor who makes ads built to perform, not just look nice. If

you've only ever done pretty edits with no understanding of what makes an ad

convert, this probably isn't for you.



You should be able to cut these ad styles confidently:



- AI UGC ads

- Voiceover + b-roll style ads

- Greenscreen / AI avatar style

- Claymation / Pixar / 3D animation style

- Podcast-style ads

- And honestly, whatever style is winning right now



You'll be making a high volume of AI-generated creative — AI UGC, claymation,

Pixar-style, podcast ads, avatars, and more — so you need to be genuinely

comfortable producing and blending AI generative assets into ads that convert.





------------------------------------------------------------

THE ACTUAL EDITING SKILLS YOU NEED

------------------------------------------------------------

This is the part people usually leave vague, so let me be specific. Day to day,

you'll need to be genuinely good at:



HOOKS & RETENTION EDITING

You understand the first 3 seconds make or break an ad. You know how to open

strong, hold attention with pattern interrupts, zooms, jump cuts, and pacing,

and keep someone watching to the CTA.



PACING & RHYTHM

You cut to the energy of the voiceover/script — tight where it needs to be,

never letting a clip drag. Your edits feel fast and snappy without being messy.



STORYTELLING TO A SCRIPT

You can take a VO or ad script and build the visual story around it: matching

b-roll, on-screen text, and beats to what's being said so the message actually

lands.



B-ROLL SOURCING & SEQUENCING

You know how to find (or generate) the right supporting footage and place it so

it reinforces the message, not just fills space.



CAPTIONS & ON-SCREEN TEXT

Clean, readable, well-timed subtitles and kinetic text — styled to match the

brand, synced properly, and used to drive retention (not just slapped on).



SOUND DESIGN

Music selection that fits the mood, proper audio leveling, SFX and "whooshes"

on transitions, ducking music under VO. Bad audio kills good visuals.



BASIC MOTION GRAPHICS & TEXT ANIMATION

Simple, clean animated text, callouts, highlights, and transitions that look

professional.



COLOR & CLEANUP

Basic correction so clips match and look consistent, plus a clean, polished

finish (no jarring cuts, no random aspect-ratio jumps).



AI GENERATION

You can actually prompt and produce usable assets — AI UGC clips, claymation,

Pixar-style, avatars, b-roll, images — and blend them into a real ad so it

doesn't look obviously AI.



ORGANIZATION

Named files, tidy project structure, hitting deadlines. You make it easy for

the team to work with you.





------------------------------------------------------------

TOOLS YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW

------------------------------------------------------------

CapCut, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Kling, Veo 3, Nano Banana, Higgsfield — and whatever

else is current in the gen-AI stack. This space changes every single week and I

need someone who actually keeps up, not someone I have to drag along.





------------------------------------------------------------

WHAT YOU'LL OWN (KPIs)

------------------------------------------------------------

DAILY OUTPUT: 2 high-quality ad creatives per day, following our scripts

and styles.



70% FIRST-PASS APPROVAL RATE: At least 7 out of 10 of your submissions should

require no revisions — meaning they match the brief and are ready to test.



AVAILABILITY: Online and responsive Monday–Friday. Weekends are optional but

encouraged for the people who want to climb the leaderboard faster.





------------------------------------------------------------

WHAT MATTERS MOST (BEYOND THE SKILLS)

------------------------------------------------------------

- DTC experience is a must. You've already worked with one or more DTC / ecom

brands — this is non-negotiable. Show me the work.



- You use AI tools daily and stay updated as new ones drop.



- Mindset — this is the big one. Coachable, fast learner, growth-oriented, and

the type who tries to overdeliver instead of doing the bare minimum.



You don't have to be perfect on day one. But you should be good enough to hit

the ground running and hungry enough to keep leveling up. We've got a head editor

who'll guide you on frameworks, hook structures, and what actually makes an ad

win — so this is a genuine chance to learn ecom and direct response from the

inside while getting paid well to do it.





------------------------------------------------------------

COMPENSATION

------------------------------------------------------------

Base retainer: $1,000–$1,500/month, depending on your skill level and

experience. Retainers go up over time as your skills grow and you take on more

responsibility.



Leaderboard bonuses — on top of your retainer. Here's how it works: the editor

with the highest number of winning ads gets first place, and so on. The whole

team is ranked on a leaderboard each month, and the top 5 editors get paid

bonuses on top of their base. The better your creatives perform, the higher you

climb, the more you earn.



???? 1st place: $[500]

???? 2nd place: $[400]

???? 3rd place: $[300]

4?? 4th place: $[200]

5?? 5th place: $[100]



We spend at a scale where this adds up to real money for editors who

consistently ship winners. The leaderboard isn't just for show — it's there so

the people putting in the work actually get rewarded for it.





------------------------------------------------------------

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

------------------------------------------------------------

- You make pretty videos but don't understand direct response. If you can't

explain why a hook works or what makes an ad convert, this isn't the role.



- You need hand-holding. You'll get guidance and frameworks from our head

editor, but you're expected to manage your own workload, hit deadlines, and

solve problems without constant check-ins.



- You're a one-tool specialist who resists learning new things. Our stack

changes weekly. If a new AI tool drops and the team adopts it overnight, you

need to pivot without frustration.



- You see this as "just a job." The people who win here are genuinely into

short-form, AI creative, and direct response — and want to grow with a

fast-scaling brand, not clock in and out.



------------------------------------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY

------------------------------------------------------------

In your proposal, include:

- The Names of the previous Ecom Brands/Companies you have edited for

- A short description of your current skillset.

- A few examples of past ad creative work (UGC, voiceover, animation —

whatever you've got) to back it up, including the DTC brand(s) you've worked

with.



Then answer these questions:



1. Pick one ad creative you've made that performed well. Break down WHY it

worked from a direct-response angle — the hook, pacing, offer, CTA, or any

specific editing choice that drove the result.



2. Tell me about a creative that underperformed. How did you use the

performance data to figure out why, what did you change in the next version,

and what happened?



3. Walk me through how you produce AI UGC or generative ads (claymation,

Pixar, podcast, avatar, etc.) so they don't look obviously AI. What's your

process and which tools do you reach for?



4. This role is high-volume — 2 creatives a day. Describe your experience

working at that kind of pace and how you keep quality high while moving fast.



Include the code word 'ScaleMode' somewhere in your application. I only review

applications that include it — it tells me you actually read the post and pay

attention to detail.



Then submit the trial task after you send your proposal.



That's it. Looking forward to seeing what you can do.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
We’re looking for a creative, highly organised and social-first Social Media Manager to join a growing UK social media agency.



You’ll work across four key accounts - three Instagram accounts and one Instagram + LinkedIn account (business and personal page) taking ownership of much of the day-to-day content creation and execution.



This isn’t a role where you’ll simply be handed content and asked to schedule it. We’re looking for someone who genuinely understands social media: what makes someone stop scrolling, why certain hooks work, how to turn a simple idea into engaging content and how to adapt your approach for completely different brands and audiences.



You’ll be working closely with the agency founder and content creator, but we’re looking for someone who can eventually take real ownership of their responsibilities, bring ideas to the table and help us make our clients’ content better.



What you’ll be doing



Your responsibilities will include:



* Developing monthly social media content ideas across multiple client accounts

* Creating detailed shoot plans and briefs for content creator

* Turning raw footage into engaging, social-first Reels using CapCut

* Developing strong hooks and testing different creative approaches

* Designing carousels, Stories and other social graphics in Canva

* Writing engaging captions in different brand tones of voice

* Planning and creating daily Instagram Stories

* Curating relevant UGC and third-party content

* Scheduling and publishing content

* Supporting day-to-day community management

* Researching trends, competitors and new content opportunities

* Creating variations of Reels for testing

* Reviewing analytics and helping identify what’s working and what we should test next

* Supporting influencer research and outreach

* Managing multiple content calendars, deadlines and deliverables

* Supporting content for our agency’s own social channels

* Working across both Instagram and LinkedIn



Who we’re looking for



You’ll have 3+ years of previous professional experience working in social media, either within an agency, as a freelancer or in-house managing brand accounts.



You should have:



* Excellent written English

* Strong copywriting skills

* Excellent Canva/design skills and a good eye for layout, typography and branding

* Strong CapCut/video-editing skills

* A genuine understanding of social-first content

* An understanding of hooks, retention and what makes short-form content engaging

* Strong content ideation skills 

* A strong understanding of LinkedIn and Instagram

* An understanding of how brand voice changes between different clients and audiences

* Strong attention to detail

* Excellent organisation and time management

* The ability to manage several accounts and deadlines simultaneously

* The ability to follow detailed instructions and brand guidelines

* Confidence using analytics to understand content performance

* Good research skills

* A proactive approach - if you see an opportunity or have a better idea, we want you to say it

* The ability to take feedback, learn from it and apply it to future work

* A reliable internet connection and computer capable of video editing

* Confidence verbally communicating 

* A collaborative, team-player mentality



Bonus points if you have:



* Previous social media agency experience

* Experience managing multiple brands at the same time

* Experience with influencer outreach

* Experience working with ideally UK brands (or USA/ Australian brands)

* Experience using project-management/content-planning tools

* Experience using AI tools effectively as part of your workflow



The person we’re looking for:



We’re interested in finding someone who thinks like a social media marketer than someone who simply knows how to use Canva and CapCut and post on Instagram.



You notice when a hook isn’t strong enough.



You can look at raw footage and see three different ways it could become a Reel.



You understand that content for one client shouldn’t sound or look exactly like content for another.



You’re organised enough that deadlines don’t need chasing, but creative enough to bring fresh ideas to the table.



You care about the small details. You check your work before submitting it and take pride in producing something you’re happy to put in front of a client.



What we offer



* Full-time, long-term remote position

* Monday–Friday working schedule

* Consistent monthly salary

* Opportunities for salary progression as the agency grows

* Training and development

* A collaborative working relationship where your ideas are genuinely valued

* Exposure to a variety of brands and industries

s

description:
Full-Time Dispatcher (Remote)



Company: Eveready Express

Engagement Type: Independent Contractor (Full-Time)

Location: Remote



About the Role



Eveready Express is seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented, and experienced Dispatcher to join our growing logistics team.



The ideal candidate must have at least two (2) years of experience working in the U.S. logistics or transportation industry and possess strong dispatching, route planning, and load coordination skills. You should thrive in a fast-paced environment, be able to effectively multitask, possess intermediate English communication skills, demonstrate expert computer skills, and have a growth mindset with a willingness to continuously learn and improve.



As a Dispatcher, you will be responsible for coordinating daily transportation operations, negotiating rates, assigning drivers, monitoring shipments, communicating with customers, and ensuring deliveries are completed safely, efficiently, and on time while maintaining compliance with DOT and ELD regulations.



Vehicles Being Dispatched

26-Foot Box Trucks (10,000 lb. weight capacity) – Dock-high with lift gate

Sprinter Vans

Cargo Vans

Ram ProMaster (High Roof)

About Eveready Express



Founded in 1984, Eveready Express is a trusted leader in trucking, courier, logistics, and distribution services. We proudly serve businesses throughout the Northeast by providing dependable transportation solutions backed by honesty, integrity, urgency, teamwork, and exceptional customer service.



Key Responsibilities

Dispatch Operations

Dispatch vehicles based on customer orders, schedules, and driver availability.

Negotiate rates with drivers while maintaining a target minimum 40% gross margin.

Assign loads efficiently to maximize profitability and operational performance.

Coordinate pickups and deliveries to ensure customer service expectations are met.

Driver Communication

Maintain continuous communication with drivers throughout their routes.

Provide dispatch instructions, updates, route changes, and operational support.

Ensure drivers follow company procedures and customer requirements.

Routing & Scheduling

Plan efficient delivery routes to minimize transit time, fuel consumption, and operating costs.

Adjust schedules quickly as operational needs or unforeseen circumstances arise.

Balance driver availability with customer delivery requirements.

Shipment Tracking

Monitor shipments in real time using GPS and dispatch software.

Proactively identify delays and coordinate solutions to minimize service disruptions.

Provide timely shipment updates to customers and internal teams.

Customer Service

Serve as the primary point of contact for customers after dispatch.

Respond professionally to customer inquiries.

Resolve delivery concerns while maintaining exceptional customer service.

Documentation & Compliance

Maintain accurate dispatch records, driver logs, shipment notes, Bills of Lading (BOLs), and Proofs of Delivery (PODs).

Ensure compliance with DOT regulations, ELD requirements, Hours of Service (HOS), company policies, and customer-specific procedures.

Problem Solving

Resolve logistical challenges including traffic delays, vehicle breakdowns, weather disruptions, missed appointments, and last-minute schedule changes.

Safety & Regulatory Compliance

Verify driver qualifications, vehicle readiness, insurance, and compliance with company safety standards.

Work closely with HR and Operations to ensure all regulatory requirements are met.

Team Collaboration

Collaborate with Customer Service, Operations, Billing, Sales, HR, Warehouse, and Drivers to ensure seamless daily operations.

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve dispatch efficiency, operational workflows, and customer satisfaction.

Recommend process improvements and innovative solutions to management.

Qualifications

Required: Minimum of 2 years of experience in the U.S. logistics or transportation industry.

Previous experience dispatching 26-foot box trucks, cargo vans, sprinter vans, or final-mile delivery vehicles is required.

Strong understanding of DOT regulations, ELD compliance, and Hours of Service (HOS) requirements.

Experience negotiating driver rates while maintaining profitability and service quality.

Expert computer skills, including the ability to quickly navigate multiple applications, browser tabs, spreadsheets, dispatch platforms, and communication tools simultaneously.

Proficiency with Transportation Management Systems (TMS), dispatch software, GPS tracking platforms, load boards, CRM systems, Microsoft Office (especially Excel), Google Workspace, and web-based applications.

Strong ability to multitask and manage multiple drivers, customers, deliveries, and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Intermediate English communication skills (written and verbal).

Excellent organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.

Comfortable communicating professionally with drivers, customers, brokers, and internal teams.

Strong critical-thinking, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.

Dependable, self-motivated, highly organized, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.

Demonstrates a growth mindset, is coachable, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning and improvement.

Must be available to work a full-time schedule, including evenings, weekends, or holidays as operational needs require.

Hardware & Technical Requirements



Applicants must have the following:



Processor: 2.0 GHz or higher (Intel Core i5/i7 or equivalent preferred)

RAM: Minimum 16 GB

Storage: At least 100 GB of available disk space

Second monitor for efficient multitasking

Backup computer

Noise-canceling headset

Internet: Minimum 20 Mbps wired connection for both your primary and backup internet service providers

USB sticks, mobile hotspots, wireless dongles, or satellite internet connections are not permitted as backup internet connections.

title: Senior Paid Media Strategist
description:
Senior Paid Media Strategist

Location: Remote, EST Hours

Type: Full-Time, Independent Contractor

Experience: 5+ years in paid media strategy, with enterprise budget ownership

Pay Range: $25-$27 per hour, based on experience

Reports to: Media Team Lead

Start Date: ASAP

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist to take full ownership of one of our largest and most complex accounts, a multi-location US home improvement brand running a seven-figure annual media program across Google Search, Performance Max, Meta, Bing and Local Services Ads, alongside a focused portfolio of established eCommerce and lead-gen clients.



This is a senior, client-facing seat, not an execution seat. You'll run the weekly client sync and the monthly performance review yourself. You'll own the numbers, the change log, and the tracking behind both. We're not looking for someone to run a plan handed to them. We're looking for the person the client trusts to say what's working, what isn't, and what we're doing about it this week.



One thing sets this role apart from most senior PPC jobs: you own measurement integrity. At this budget level, a broken conversion action or a mis-scoped tag isn't a reporting inconvenience. It silently misdirects bidding and burns real money before anyone notices. We need someone who treats GA4 and Google Tag Manager as core craft, not as someone else's job.



You'll be supported by a Media Team Lead, a Performance Marketing Specialist, dedicated creative and
 teams, and an internal AI stack we actively build on. What you won't have is someone checking your work for you. That's the level we're hiring at.

What You'll Be Doing

Account Ownership & Client Leadership

Serve as the senior day-to-day owner for your accounts, including our high-ticket lead gen clients

Lead weekly client syncs and monthly performance reviews independently: set the agenda, present the numbers, defend the recommendation

Translate business goals (cost per appointment, cost per lead, revenue targets) into media plans, and translate results back into plain language

Own budget pacing and reallocation across markets, products and platforms; flag over- and under-delivery before month-end, not after

Maintain a clean, current change log so every performance movement can be traced to a decision

Measurement & Tracking Integrity

s, and change logs equally

mbers are required to track their working time using Hubstaff. Hubstaff is used for task-level time tracking and supports transparency, accurate billing, and fair workload management across the team.

title: Creative Project Manager & Design Operations Specialist
description:
Role overview: 

You are the operational backbone of a small creative studio. You own client communication, project flow, and quality control, and you execute design work directly when the primary designer is unavailable. The founder’s name is on every deliverable. Your job is to make sure nothing leaves the studio that the founder would not proudly sign.



Client Communication & Proactive Reporting

• Acknowledge every client request quickly with a clear, realistic timeline

• Send status updates on a set cadence (Mon/Wed/Fri minimum) without being asked

• When a client sends assets, materials, or information, notify the founder same day with what arrived, what it is for, and the deadline

• Update clients proactively when timelines shift, manage urgency without letting everything become urgent



Project Management

• Translate requests into fully scoped ClickUp tasks: complete instructions, correct files and Drive links, client history, due dates matching commitments

• Route work to the primary designer first, take on execution when they are at capacity

• Schedule against real capacity, flag conflicts early with proposed solutions

Design QA (Non-Negotiable)

• Every deliverable is verified before it ships: kerning, spacing, alignment, weight consistency, resolution, export quality, copy accuracy

• When modifying existing brand assets, work from and verify against the source file. Never repurpose an old asset as new work

• A 5-minute edit gets the same precision as a full project



Direct Design Execution

• The primary designer works async off-hours. When time-sensitive requests land, you execute them yourself to full professional standard: logo lockups, typography adjustments, layout corrections, production edits

• If a request exceeds your skill level, say so immediately and set expectations. Never attempt-and-ship



Admin & Organization

• Draft scopes of work from provided formulas, track approvals, send W-9s and documents

• Maintain clean Drive structure and naming conventions

Tools: ClickUp, Google Drive, Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, Canva, 
. Working familiarity with Shopify, Webflow, WordPress, Squarespace, Wix.





Required skills

• Proven production design ability with a portfolio showing typography and logo lockup work

• Trained design eye, spots kerning and weight issues without being told

• Track record managing clients and projects for a small team or agency

• Proactive reporting habits, demonstrated, not claimed

• Honest self-assessment of skill limits

Nice-to-have: packaging or print design, experience supporting a creative founder or studio, retainer vs project familiarity
