title: Part-Time WordPress, WooCommerce & SEO Assistant – Long-Term UK Client
description:
# Part-Time WordPress, WooCommerce & SEO Assistant



### Long-Term UK Client | Every Monday | $5 Per Hour



We are looking for an **experienced WordPress, WooCommerce and SEO Virtual Assistant** to become the person we trust to maintain and improve our company websites.



This is a **long-term, permanent part-time role** working every Monday with our UK-based businesses.



We currently operate:



* Salon Deliver – professional hair-product distribution

* Mulberry & Flitch – luxury hair salons and online retail

* Cosmos Football Community – a new football business with a small online shop launching later



Our websites use:



**WordPress | WooCommerce | Elementor | Yoast SEO**



There are approximately **800 products across our two main websites**.



This is **not a web-development or coding position**. We need someone who already knows WordPress and WooCommerce and can confidently maintain e-commerce websites.



## HOURS & PAY



**Every Monday

9:00am–5:00pm UK time**



30-minute unpaid break.



**7.5 paid hours per week**

**$5 USD per hour**

**$150 every four weeks**



We pay every four weeks, giving **13 pay periods per year**.



Additional paid hours may occasionally be available for large product launches, price changes or other projects.



You must be available for communication with our UK office throughout your Monday working day.



## WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your responsibilities will include:



* Add new WooCommerce products

* Update existing products

* Research new products using Google and AI

* Write and improve product descriptions

* Research keywords and improve SEO

* Complete Yoast SEO titles and meta descriptions

* Improve existing product listings

* Update prices from supplier price lists

* Check prices are correct after updates

* Upload, resize and optimise product images

* Create image filenames and ALT text

* Make simple Elementor text, image, button and link changes

* Create simple promotional graphics

* Help create our monthly Salon Deliver deal sheet using Canva

* Update approved WordPress plugins

* Check websites after plugin updates

* Test shopping carts and checkout

* Test contact forms

* Test discount codes

* Check important links

* Check mobile and desktop display

* Maintain spreadsheets using Google Sheets or Excel

* Identify problems and report them

* Suggest ideas to improve the websites



## SEO IS IMPORTANT



We are not looking for someone who simply uploads products.



When urgent work is completed, you will systematically work through our existing products and improve:



* Keywords

* Product titles

* Product descriptions

* SEO titles

* Meta descriptions

* ALT text

* Categories

* Internal links

* Search visibility



We want someone who is interested in helping our websites **rank better on Google and generate more sales**.



## AI IS ENCOURAGED



We actively use **ChatGPT and other AI tools**.



You should be comfortable using AI for:



* Product research

* Keyword ideas

* SEO

* Product descriptions

* Competitor research

* Proofreading

* Problem solving



However, **AI-generated information must always be checked before publishing**.



Never guess product information, prices or claims.



## REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You must already have practical experience with:



* WordPress

* WooCommerce

* Elementor

* Adding and editing products

* Basic SEO

* Keyword research

* Google Sheets or Excel

* Good written English



Experience with **Yoast SEO, Canva and ChatGPT** is strongly preferred.



You do not need to be a programmer.



Serious coding, server or plugin-conflict issues will be passed to a specialist.



## WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should be:



* Experienced

* Reliable

* Accurate

* Highly organised

* Good at communicating

* Comfortable asking questions

* Able to work independently

* Very attentive to detail

* Comfortable researching information

* Interested in learning

* Interested in a long-term position



If you see a mistake or problem, we expect you to tell us.



If you are unsure about something, ask.



We would rather you double-check than guess.



## HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words:



**MONDAY WEBSITE**



Applications that do not start with these words may not be considered.



Please answer the following questions:



**1. How many years have you worked with WordPress and WooCommerce?**



**2. Please provide links to one or two e-commerce websites you have worked on and explain what you did.**



**3. What experience do you have using Elementor?**



**4. What experience do you have with Yoast SEO or other SEO tools?**



**5. Explain briefly how you would research the best keyword for a new product page.**



**6. How do you currently use ChatGPT or other AI tools in your work?**



**7. Are you available every Monday from 9:00am–5:00pm UK time?**



**8. Are you happy with a rate of $5 USD per hour?**



Please do not send us a long generic cover letter. We are much more interested in your answers and your real experience.



## SHORT PRACTICAL TEST



Strong applicants will be invited to complete a short **20–30 minute practical test**.



We will give you a sample product and ask you to prepare:



* Product title

* Short description

* Full description

* Primary SEO keyword

* Supporting keywords

* SEO title

* Meta description

* Suggested product category

* Product tags

* Image filename

* Image ALT text

* Suggested internal links



You may use **Google, ChatGPT and other AI tools**.



We want to see how you research, think and check information.



If you cannot verify something, we would much rather you tell us than guess.



## WHAT HAPPENS NEXT?



Our process is simple:



**Application ? Practical Test ? Short Video Interview ? Decision**



We are looking to appoint someone quickly.



This could be an excellent opportunity for an experienced WordPress/WooCommerce freelancer or VA who would like a **reliable, permanent Monday client and a long-term relationship with a UK company**.



If you are experienced, accurate, reliable and enjoy improving e-commerce websites, we would be pleased to hear from you.

title: Senior Talent Sourcer — AdTech / Programmatic GTM
description:
GCN Recruiting | Remote (Philippines) | Long-Term Contract

Who we are



GCN Recruiting is a New York-based executive search and RPO firm specializing in AdTech and MarTech. We place senior GTM leaders — VP Sales, GM, CRO, Agency Partnership Directors — for enterprise clients in the programmatic advertising, CTV, and data ecosystem.



What this role is

I know this is a lot, but it is a very, very specific job so please go through the description below and only apply if you are qualified. I really appreciate it- thank you!



This is a dedicated sourcing and market intelligence role. You will not manage client relationships or run full-cycle recruiting. Your job is to build structured talent intelligence every month and hand off warm, qualified prospects to our US-based senior recruiter for screening.



This role has three distinct monthly deliverables. All three are required every month.



DELIVERABLE 1 — Talent Map



Build 2 structured talent maps per month, each covering a defined GTM function and geography in the AdTech/programmatic ecosystem.



Each map must include:



A defined universe of target companies, tiered by talent density

Named individuals at the right seniority level — title, company, LinkedIn URL, approximate tenure

One-line sourcing note per person explaining why they are relevant

Clean, consistent formatting — ready to present to a client without cleanup



Volume: 150–200 named profiles per map minimum. This is research work, not a quick search.



DELIVERABLE 2 — Sourced Candidate Profiles



Each month, identify and deliver 10 fully sourced candidate profiles that are validated as a correct fit for an active executive search.



Each profile must include:



Full LinkedIn profile link

Current title, company, and tenure

Compensation range estimate where available

Why this person fits the specific search criteria — written in your own words, not copy-pasted from their profile

Any publicly available context that makes them relevant — recent promotions, company news, role changes



These profiles go directly to the US recruiter. They must be right. Volume over quality is not acceptable here.



DELIVERABLE 3 — 10 Candidates Ready for US Recruiter Screening



Each month, conduct initial outreach to passive candidates, qualify their interest, and pass forward 10 candidates who are warm, responsive, and credibly interested in exploring a conversation.



Each candidate passed forward must have:



Confirmed interest in speaking with a recruiter

Basic qualification confirmed — level, geography, compensation range in the right ballpark

A brief outreach summary — what you said, what they said, and why you are passing them forward



These 10 people will be spoken to by our US-based senior recruiter. Your job is to make sure that time is not wasted. Every candidate you pass forward must be worth a call.



Monthly summary: 2 talent maps + 10 sourced and validated profiles + 10 warm candidates handed off to US recruiter. This is a full workload. We estimate 30–40 hours per month minimum for someone who knows the AdTech ecosystem well. If you are learning it as you go, this role will be too demanding.



This is serious work. We want someone who delivers something clean, organized, and genuinely useful — not a list of random names pulled from a keyword search.



What you must already know



This is not an entry-level role and we will not be teaching AdTech fundamentals. You need to already understand:



The programmatic advertising ecosystem — the buy side, sell side, and the infrastructure in between

The major GTM functions at an AdTech company and what each one actually does day to day

The difference between agency sales, brand direct, and platform BD as career paths

Why CTV and connected TV represents a distinct and fast-growing talent segment

How senior GTM talent moves through this ecosystem — who hires from whom and why



If you are not already familiar with these concepts, this role is not the right fit. Please do not apply.



What you must be able to do

Advanced Boolean search across LinkedIn and other platforms

LinkedIn Recruiter or Sales Navigator — proficient, not learning

Build clean, structured deliverables with consistent formatting

Write professional, concise outreach messages to senior US executives in fluent English

Work independently, hit monthly delivery deadlines, and flag issues early

How to apply — read this carefully



Do not send a generic resume or cover letter. We will not review them.



Answer these three questions. Your answers are the application.



1. Without looking anything up, name five companies you would target first if asked to map VP-level Agency Sales talent in the US programmatic ecosystem. For each one, explain in one sentence why that company produces this type of talent.



2. Walk me through how you would build a talent map for a specific GTM function from scratch. What sources would you use beyond LinkedIn, and how would you organize the output?



3. What is your monthly rate for approximately 30–40 hours of sourcing and market mapping work per month?



Applications that do not answer all three questions in full will not be opened.



What you get

Long-term monthly contract — this is not a one-time project

Clear deliverables and scope — no ambiguity, no micromanagement

Work directly with the founder of GCN Recruiting

Paid test project to start — strong work leads immediately to an ongoing engagement

title: Lead Amazon Account Manager
description:
Read this part first

If your Amazon experience is primarily Sponsored Ads / Quartile / PPC platform work, this role is not for you. We have plenty of PPC strength on the team. What we need is the person who can run everything else too: catalog governance, Brand Registry conflicts, A+ and Storefront direction, FBA inventory health, account suspensions, listing suppression recovery, Vendor Central chargebacks, launch sequencing and then lead PPC strategy on top of that.



This is a full-stack Amazon operator role with team lead responsibilities. It will fail you if your experience is shaped narrowly.



About the Role

As Amazon Marketplace Team Lead at ScaledOn, you will own end-to-end strategy and execution for 4–6 client brands simultaneously. You are the senior person on the account the one our PPC Specialists, VAs, and Amazon Managers escalate to, and the one our clients trust to run their entire Amazon presence as if it were your own brand.



You move fluently between Seller Central and Vendor Central, you have built launches from listing draft to first 100 organic orders, and you have personally fought Amazon Support for things that mattered. PPC is one of the levers you pull, not your whole job.



Responsibilities

Own the full Amazon P&L for each of your client brands — revenue, contribution margin, ACOS, TACOS, CPO, organic rank, and account health, all of it.

Diagnose and resolve Seller Central / Vendor Central operational issues: account suspensions, listing suppressions, Brand Registry conflicts, variation structure failures, IPI scores, FBA shipment issues, A+ violations, support case escalation.

Drive new product launches end-to-end: keyword research, listing/SEO direction, parent/child variation strategy, review generation approach, ranking goals, sequencing, and launch budget.

Lead Amazon Ads strategy across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and Amazon Attribution including Quartile rule design, override decisions, and validation against business outcomes (not just platfor
trics).

Build weekly reporting narratives that connect actions to results to next steps, in plain English a client CEO would understand.

Lead client strategy and performance calls with US-based stakeholders. You set the agenda, you frame the data, you own the room.

Mentor and lead Amazon Managers, PPC Specialists, and VAs assigned to your accounts. Create and enforce SOPs.

Identify expansion opportunities — international Amazon, Walmart, additional categories — and own the path to execution.

Required experience (proof-of-work, not years)

To pass this stage, you need to be able to point to specific examples for each:

You have personally led recovery of an account suspension, listing suppression, or Brand Registry conflict.

You have personally cleaned up a parent/child variation structure across 10+ ASINs to fix groupings or restore reviews.

You have personally launched at least three new products from draft listing to organic page-1 ranking in their primary keyword.

You have personally operated both Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts. (If only one — explain in the additional details section of the application.)

You have personally read FBA Inventory Performance / Storage Limit / Restock reports and acted on them in the last 90 days.

You have personally led Amazon Ads strategy using Quartile or a comparable platform — including overriding the algorithm when you were right and it was wrong.

You have personally led weekly client strategy calls with US-based stakeholders.

You have personally built and enforced SOPs for an Amazon team.

Expert-level Excel / Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, data cleaning, building reporting models).

Excellent written and spoken English (B2/C1); confident running strategy calls.



How you use AI

You treat AI and automation as force multipliers. You can show us at least one real workflow you use weekly: a Custom GPT, a Claude project, a script, a Zapier/Make flow, a bulk-sheet automation that has materially saved you time. We will ask you to describe it specifically. Generic "I use ChatGPT for copy" answers will be deprioritized.



You are NOT a fit if…

Your Amazon experience is primarily ads / PPC. (We need a full-stack operator. PPC is one piece of the role.)

Your marketplace experience is primarily on Shopee, Mercado Livre, eBay, Walmart, or another non-Amazon platform — even if you also touch Amazon. They do not transfer in the ways that matter.

You have worked at an Amazon ad-tech vendor (Quartile, Pacvue, Perpetua, Helium 10, Jungle Scout, etc.) but have not personally operated end-to-end client Amazon accounts that included catalog, ops, and account health work.

You are uncomfortable with deep account ownership over breadth; this role goes deep on 4–6 brands, not shallow on 20.

You are uncomfortable with time tracking (Hubstaff), structured weekly reporting, or being on US-time client calls.

$20–$25/hr USD as a contractor isn't a rate you can accept. We're transparent about this upfront so neither of us wastes time.



You are currently ONLY HIRING in the Philippines or LATAM. 



About ScaledOn

ScaledOn is a fully remote ecommerce growth agency. We are entrepreneurs first and marketers second. We have built and scaled our own brands, and we run client accounts the way we ran our own: with profit-and-margin discipline, full-funnel tracking, and AI-powered execution layered on real human judgment.



This is an independent contractor position. Compensation is $20–$25 USD per hour, roughly 40 hrs/week, paid as a contractor invoice. We hire from the Philippines and LATAM must overlap at least 4 hours/day with US Eastern time for client calls. Hiring includes assessments and a multi-week paid trial period to ensure mutual fit. We use Hubstaff for task-level time tracking. It is how we keep workloads fair across a global team and how we earn our clients' trust on billing.

Perks include certifications, annual performance bonuses, individual career-growth planning, paid time off, and summer Fridays.



How to apply

Apply here: 

Heads up: the application has three short-answer questions designed to pressure-test full-stack Amazon experience. Specifics over generalizations. Vague answers will be deprioritized. Total time should be 8–12 minutes.

title: Senior Real Estate Photo Editor / Retoucher – Adobe + AI Specialist
description:
Full-Time, Permanent Remote Role | Philippines



Australian Real Estate Photography Studio

Impress Photography is looking for an experienced and highly skilled Real Estate Photo Editor / Retoucher to join our production team in a full-time, ongoing permanent role.



This is not a short-term contract, casual position or temporary freelance opportunity. We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term and valued member of the Impress Photography team.



For nearly 15 years, Impress Photography has been one of Melbourne, Australia’s leading photographic studios, specialising in high-end residential and commercial real estate photography, aerial photography and video, hotel and tourism photography, and premium property marketing.



We are looking for someone who takes genuine pride in their work and wants to become an important part of a professional, close-knit Australian production team.



This is not simply a high-volume HDR editing position.



We want an editor with an excellent eye for detail, strong Photoshop and retouching skills, an understanding of premium real estate imagery, and the ability to consistently produce polished, natural and high-end results.

We are also embracing AI throughout our real estate photography production workflow. An important part of this role will involve learning, using and becoming highly proficient with specific AI software designed for real estate photography and image production, alongside Adobe Photoshop, Lightroom, Firefly and other emerging AI applications.



What You’ll Be Doing:

You will work closely with our Australian production team, editing and retouching professional real estate, commercial, hotel and tourism photography.

Your work may include:

High-end real estate photo editing and retouching

Interior and exterior property photography

HDR and exposure blending

Flambient editing

Window pulls and natural window views

Colour correction and white balance

Perspective and vertical correction

Highlight and shadow recovery

Sky replacement where appropriate

Lawn, garden and exterior enhancements

Object and distraction removal

TV screen and fireplace replacement

Pool and water enhancement

Removing unwanted reflections and colour casts

Advanced Photoshop retouching

Drone and aerial photography editing

Twilight and dusk image enhancement

Image quality control and consistency

Matching the established Impress Photography editing style

Using specialised real estate AI editing software as part of our daily production workflow

Reviewing AI-generated edits and professionally retouching or correcting them where required

Combining traditional Photoshop techniques with AI-assisted workflows to achieve premium results

Helping us test and adopt new AI tools as photographic technology continues to evolve

Adobe, Real Estate AI & Emerging Technology

Technology is becoming an increasingly important part of professional real estate photography production.

We want someone who is technically strong, curious and excited to learn.

A significant part of this position will involve using specific AI software developed for real estate photography. Full training in our preferred systems and workflows can be provided, but you must be comfortable learning new software and adapting as technology changes.

You may work with:

Adobe Photoshop

Adobe Lightroom

Adobe Firefly

Photoshop Generative Fill

Specialised real estate AI editing platforms

AI HDR and image processing software

AI masking and selection tools

AI object removal

AI image enhancement

AI sky and environmental adjustments

AI virtual twilight and property enhancement tools

AI upscaling and sharpening

AI workflow and productivity applications

Other emerging photographic and real estate AI technologies

We are not looking for AI to replace good editing.

We are looking for someone who understands great photography and professional retouching first, then knows how to use AI intelligently to achieve better results, greater consistency and more efficient workflows.

Importantly, AI-generated results still need a great human eye.

You will be expected to recognise when an AI edit is excellent — and when it needs additional professional retouching to meet the Impress Photography standard.

What We’re Looking For

Ideally, you will already have several years of professional experience editing and retouching real estate photography.

You should have:

Excellent Adobe Photoshop skills

Strong Adobe Lightroom skills

Professional real estate photo retouching experience

An excellent understanding of colour, exposure and composition

Strong HDR and exposure blending skills

Experience with window pulls

Experience with flambient editing

Strong object removal and retouching skills

Experience editing luxury or high-end property photography

Excellent attention to detail

The ability to produce natural-looking, premium results

Good knowledge of AI editing applications

Experience with Adobe Firefly and Photoshop AI tools

Confidence learning specialised real estate AI software

A genuine interest in emerging AI technology

A willingness to learn new AI applications and workflows

Excellent Mac or PC workflow skills

Strong time-management skills

The ability to follow detailed editing instructions

The ability to accept feedback and continually improve

Communication, Reliability & Honesty

This part of the role is extremely important to us.

Excellent written and spoken English, strong communication skills, reliability and honesty are essential.

You will be working remotely from the Philippines, but you will be considered a genuine part of our Melbourne-based production team.

We need someone we can trust to communicate clearly, follow through on commitments, meet deadlines and take responsibility for their work.

We are looking for someone who:

Has excellent spoken and written English

Has strong interpersonal and communication skills

Is reliable, honest and trustworthy

Communicates clearly, professionally and confidently

Is dependable and follows through on commitments

Takes responsibility for their work

Is comfortable communicating regularly with our Melbourne team

Is confident speaking in tea
etings and video calls

Asks questions when something is unclear

Meets agreed deadlines

Responds positively to feedback

Wants to improve and develop

Enjoys being part of a team

Is looking for a stable, permanent and long-term career opportunity

Reliability, honesty and strong communication are non-negotiable for this position.

Technical ability is extremely important, but we also want someone we can trust and genuinely enjoy working with.

Your Eye for Detail Matters

We work with beautiful properties and demanding clients, and small details matter.

We notice things such as:

Incorrect colour casts

Crooked verticals

Overdone HDR

Unnatural skies

Poor window pulls

Inconsistent lighting

Reflections that should have been removed

Distracting objects

Unrealistic AI edits

AI-generated artefacts or errors

Oversaturated grass or skies

Poor masking

Inconsistent editing between images in the same property

If you are the type of editor who notices these things before someone else has to point them out, we want to hear from you.

AI Knowledge Is Important

Photography production is changing rapidly, and AI is becoming an important part of how we work.

We want someone who is excited by this rather than intimidated by it.

You do not need to know every AI application currently available. What matters is that you have a strong technical foundation, are comfortable learning new software and are interested in finding better ways of producing exceptional imagery.

Part of your ongoing role will be working with specialist real estate AI applications selected by Impress Photography, learning these platforms and incorporating them into our established production workflow.

As new technologies become available, we will continue testing and adopting tools that can improve quality, consistency and efficiency.

We are particularly interested in candidates who can combine photography, Photoshop, retouching, real estate AI and great judgement.

Working With Our Melbourne Team

Impress Photography is based in Hawthorn, Melbourne, Australia.

One of the great advantages of working with a Philippines-based team is the strong timezone overlap between the Philippines and Melbourne.

You will need to be available during agreed working hours that provide good overlap with our Melbourne production team.

Reliable communication throughout your working day is essential.

You will be expected to be available for team communication, feedback, workflow discussions, training and occasional video meetings.

Equipment & Internet

Because this is a professional remote production position, you will need:

A high-performance computer suitable for professional Photoshop editing

A quality, colour-accurate monitor

Reliable high-speed internet

A professional and stable remote working environment

Reliable backup internet access

The ability to transfer large photographic files efficiently

The ability to run professional Adobe and AI-based editing applications

Please include your computer specifications and internet speed with your application.

Why Join Impress Photography?

This is an opportunity to become part of an established Australian photography business rather than simply processing anonymous editing jobs.

Most importantly, this is an ongoing permanent position.

We are investing in finding the right person, training them in our systems and building a long-term working relationship.

You will:

Have the security of an ongoing, long-term role

Become a genuine part of the Impress Photography production team

Work with high-quality professional photography

Edit beautiful residential and commercial properties

Work across real estate, hotel, tourism and aerial imagery

Work closely with an experienced Australian photographic team

Develop your skills in high-end real estate retouching

Receive training in our specialist real estate AI workflows

Work with emerging Adobe and AI technology

Be part of a friendly, close-knit and supportive production team

Have the opportunity to take on greater responsibility as you develop

Build a stable, long-term career with Impress Photography

For an exceptional editor, there is also potential over time to take on quality control, training, workflow management and senior production responsibilities.

Who This Role Is Not For

This role will probably not suit you if you are:

Looking for occasional freelance work

Looking for a short-term or temporary position

Applying to many jobs without reading the job description

Unable to commit to regular agreed working hours

Frequently unavailable during your working day

title: Senior Personal Injury Litigation Case Manager
description:
Havenridge Incorporated is seeking an experienced Senior Personal Injury Litigation Case Manager to support a U.S. personal injury law practice.



This is NOT an entry-level legal assistant or virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone with substantial, hands-on experience managing U.S. Personal Injury litigation matters after a Complaint has been filed.



Applicants whose experience is primarily intake, medical records retrieval, pre-litigation administration, customer service, or general virtual assistance should not apply.



The person selected for this position must be capable of entering an active litigation environment, reviewing existing matters, identifying outstanding tasks and deadlines, and independently moving cases forward with limited supervision.



CLIO EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED. You must have actual professional experience using Clio Manage in a U.S. law firm. Familiarity from demonstrations, training courses, tutorials, or personal study does not qualify.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Manage an active caseload of Personal Injury litigation matters from filing through resolution

• Review existing case files and independently identify outstanding tasks, deficiencies, and next steps

• Maintain accurate and complete matters within Clio Manage

• Track court dates, statutory deadlines, discovery deadlines, depositions, mediations, hearings, and other litigation events

• Create and maintain attorney calendar events and deadline reminders

• Prepare, organize, and assist with pleadings, motions, notices, discovery, discovery responses, subpoenas, and other litigation documents

• Draft and prepare documents from firm templates and attorney instructions

• Coordinate electronic filing and service of litigation documents

• Monitor incoming discovery and ensure responses are completed before deadlines

• Communicate directly with clients regarding discovery, documents, appointments, case requirements, and case status

• Communicate professionally with opposing counsel, insurance representatives, medical providers, experts, vendors, and court personnel when required

• Obtain, review, organize, and maintain medical records, medical bills, liens, employment records, police reports, and other evidence

• Maintain organized electronic litigation files and ensure documents are properly named, uploaded, categorized, and accessible

• Assist attorneys with deposition, mediation, arbitration, and trial preparation

• Follow up independently on outstanding assignments rather than waiting to be reminded

• Maintain detailed case notes documenting activity and outstanding issues

• Escalate attorney-level issues promptly while independently handling matters within the scope of the position

• Work within established workflows while adapting to changing priorities and urgent litigation needs



MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS



• Professional experience working for a U.S. Personal Injury law firm

• Substantial hands-on litigation experience

• Previous responsibility for managing active litigation matters—not simply assisting another case manager with isolated tasks

• Professional experience using Clio Manage

• Experience tracking litigation deadlines and attorney calendars

• Experience with discovery and litigation document preparation

• Experience communicating directly with U.S. clients

• Strong written and spoken English

• Strong organizational skills and extreme attention to detail

• Ability to manage multiple active cases and competing deadlines

• Ability to work independently without continuous supervision

• Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and professional remote workspace

• Availability during required U.S. Central Time working hours



DO NOT APPLY IF:



• You have never worked for a U.S. law firm

• You have never worked on Personal Injury litigation matters

• Your Personal Injury experience is exclusively pre-litigation

• You have never personally managed litigation deadlines

• You have never used Clio Manage professionally

• Your Clio experience comes only from training, tutorials, certifications, or self-study

• You require step-by-step supervision to determine what needs to happen next on a case

• You are applying based primarily on general VA, customer service, or administrative experience



HIRING PROCESS



Candidates who meet the initial requirements may be asked detailed questions regarding their litigation experience before advancing.



Finalists will participate in a paid training and practical evaluation period. Candidates will be evaluated on actual work performance, including accuracy, litigation knowledge, organization, judgment, ability to follow instructions, ability to identify outstanding issues, and ability to work independently.



Please accurately represent your experience. We are specifically seeking candidates who have performed this work professionally, not candidates who are simply willing to learn it.



To apply, include a detailed description of your U.S. Personal Injury litigation experience, the approximate number of litigation cases you have managed simultaneously, your responsibilities after a Complaint was filed, and how you have used Clio Manage in your previous position.



Please submit your application directly to 
 should include:



* Your resume

* A detailed description of your U.S. Personal Injury litigation experience

* The approximate number of litigation cases you have managed simultaneously

* Your responsibilities after a Complaint was filed

* A description of how you used Clio Manage in your previous position



Applications submitted without the requested information may not be considered.

description:
Summary

Product Video Ad Animator (Remote)



We're building out our paid social creative, and we're looking for animators to own our video output.



The Role



You'll work directly with the Creative Director turning finished concepts into short animated versions using adobe to create animations and visuals for our product. You will use AI as needed for 3d models. You'll receive recieve a mock up of what we are looking for. Your job is to get a clean, on-brand result out of the tool without the usual artifacts, warping, or drift, and to know when to re-roll versus when to fix it in post.



We own all concepting and creative direction. You own execution.



Volume starts at one piece per week and can grow.



What We're Really Looking For



Skill comes first. This is an execution role and the work either holds up or it doesn't. Anyone can get a mediocre result out of these tools — we need someone who consistently gets clean ones, knows the failure modes, ATTENTION TO DETAIL,  and can tell the difference between a shot that needs a re-roll and one that can be saved in post.



Second, and nearly as important: how you handle revisions. Feedback here is direct and frequent, and because you're working from a still and a short note, a lot rides on whether you can read a note and understand what we meant, not just what it said. We need someone who takes feedback without friction, turns it around fast, and doesn't treat a revision request as a referendum on their taste.



Third: reliability. Respond on time, flag problems early, deliver when you said you would. Great work that shows up late or goes silent mid-project doesn't help us.



Requirements



Proven skill in Adobe After Effects, with reel to back it up (most important)

Proven skill with image-to-video AI, with reel to back it up (most important)

Fast, clean revision turnaround

Strong written English and reading comprehension

title: YouTube Channel Optimiser / YouTube SEO Specialist
description:
Overview

Heads Up is a UK consultancy helping school leaders move their schools from good to great and create excellent schools. We work with Primary, Secondary and Special School headteachers and senior leaders across three areas:

- having difficult conversations with staff

- moving a good school to great

- continuing excellence for heads already leading great schools.



We have an existing YouTube channel with content that isn't currently optimised for discovery or lead generation. We are not looking to create new content at this stage — the priority is making what already exists work harder and to be able to continue to do so as new content is created.



What We Need

A five-week project in three phases:

 

Phase 1 — Audit (Week 1)

— Review the channel and deliver a written audit before making any changes

— Identify which videos have most potential and what's missing

— Give us recommendations, with three priority recommendations

— Analyse traffic source data to understand how people are currently finding the channel — YouTube search, suggested videos, external sources, browse features

— Research what headteachers are actually searching for on YouTube that connects to the problems Heads Up solves, so titles and descriptions in Phase 2 are built on real search behaviour



Phase 2 — Optimisation (Weeks 3–5)

— Rewrite and optimise titles to match real headteacher search behaviour and Heads Up brand voice

— Rewrite and optimise descriptions — first 2–3 lines matter most; include relevant language naturally and in line with current best practice

— Update tags across all videos

— Add captions to every video so they are always present

— Add chapters (named timestamps) to video descriptions to aid navigation and improve search visibility

— Add or update cards and end screens on every video

— Add a like prompt to every video to support the algorithm

— Optimise the channel page and playlist structure around the three Heads Up pathways

— Ensure all links use UTM tracking so
 sign-ups from YouTube can be measured in Google Analytics



CTAs — where and what

Every video should have a consistent CTA stack. The primary destination across all placements is the relevant lead magnet or
 sign-up. The secondary CTA is always watch next / subscribe.

— End screen (every video) — subscribe button, watch next video, and lead magnet link in the final 5–20 seconds

— Description (every video) — CTA in the first 2–3 lines (visible before “show more”) and again at the end of the full description

— Pinned comment (every video) — pointing to the key resource or next step

— Verbal mention (almost every video) — spoken prompt directing viewers to the link in the description; only omit if the video is very short or the prompt would feel forced

— Card (selective) — pop-up link at a natural 
nt mid-video; use where content naturally references something, do not force it



Success criteria

1. Every video has an optimised title, description, tags, captions, and a clear CTA

2. Cards and end screens direct viewers to the correct destination, including a ‘watch this next’ recommendation

3. The channel page and playlists are clean and structured around the three Heads Up pathways

4. All links use UTM tracking so
 sign-ups from YouTube can be measured in Google Analytics



Phase 3 — One-page handover guide and insights

This phase delivers two things:

1. A reference guide so Heads Up can stay optimised going forward

— What was changed on each video and why

— A simple one-page reference Heads Up can use to maintain best practice going forward

2. Insights that will make future video content itself stronger — better structured, better performing, and easier to optimise from the start

— Audience retention data — at what point do viewers drop off, and what does that tell us about content length and structure in the video itself

— Which videos are performing best and why — topics, titles, format

— Best practice recommendations for future videos, covering both how to optimise a video once it’s live and how to structure content before filming so it performs better from day one

This list is not exhaustive — there will be more.



What We'll Provide

— Editor (Limited) access to the YouTube channel

— Our client messaging document

— Our Brand Book so you can retain our brand voice

— Clarity on CTA destinations before Phase 2 begins



What We Won't Provide

— Access to our website backend, Google account, or any other internal systems



Deliverables

Week 1: Written audit — no changes made yet

Week 2: Review and discussion — review audit findings, agree priorities, and confirm CTA destinations before optimisation begins

Weeks 3–5: Full channel optimisation

Week 5: One-page handover guide



Application question

Please send your applications through this online jobs portal.



Heads Up is a UK consultancy helping school leaders move from good to great. We have an existing YouTube channel that isn't yet optimised for discovery.



You have two options — choose one:



Option A: Analyse the Heads Up YouTube channel directly 



Option B: Find a YouTube channel in a professional services or coaching space (any industry) that you think is doing a good job of YouTube SEO



Whichever you choose, answer the following. Maximum 200 words per answer.



1.What is one specific thing being done with titles that helps the channel get found — and what makes it work?

2.What is one thing being done with cards, end screens, or CTAs that keeps viewers engaged or converts them — and why does it work?

3.What is the single biggest discoverability opportunity you can see — and how would you act on it?



Please be specific. Generic answers that could apply to any channel will not be considered. Include the channel name and URL.



Put application number #0005 in the subject line.

We're looking for a Remote Events Coordinator to join our growing team!



If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy keeping projects organized, and love bringing events to life behind the scenes, this could be the perfect role for you. You'll play a key role in coordinating events from initial inquiry through successful execution, working closely with clients, vendors, and internal tea
mbers to ensure every detail is handled with care. No two days look the same, and that's exactly what makes this role exciting.



Our SCORE Values



Solution-Focused – Think critically and proactively solve problems.

Curiosity – Ask questions and always seek to learn.

Ownership – Take accountability for your work and follow through.

Resourcefulness – Find answers, adapt quickly, and make things happen.

After 3 Months

title: TikTok Short-Form Video Editor
description:
I'm a US-based TikTok Shop affiliate creator. I film 5 to 10 short vertical videos a day for supplement, grooming, apparel and pet brands. I need one editor who is genuinely good at short-form retention editing to take over all of it, long term.



This is not general video editing. If your reel is weddings, corporate, YouTube long-form or motion graphics, we are not a fit and I'd rather you skip this one.



WHAT YOU'D DO, EVERY DAY



- Cut 5 to 10 raw talking-head and demo clips into finished 30 to 60 second vertical videos

- Build the first 3 seconds so people stop scrolling. This is the whole job. My delivery and my script are already strong; my openings leak viewers.

- Cut on the words. No dead air, no pauses, no breath gaps between sentences

- Assemble 3-clip openings: two or three fast cuts inside the first 1 to 2 seconds

- Add clean on-screen text hooks and kinetic captions (white text, black outline, readable, not fancy)

- Drop in B-roll and product cutaways at the right beat

- Place image overlays where a claim can't be seen. A lot of what I sell is supplements, where there is nothing to point a camera at. The overlays are the visual. I hand you an asset library and a list of which line each image belongs to, and using it is part of the job, not optional

- Actually use the footage I send you. If I shoot the product being used, it goes in the cut. This is the single most common note I get and I need it to stop

- Light color and audio cleanup, background audio bed where it helps

- Export ready to post, named to a simple convention



REQUIRED



- Proven short-form vertical work. TikTok, Reels or Shorts. Send 2 to 3 actual videos you cut, links not a showreel.

- CapCut fluency (that's my workflow; Premiere or Resolve fine as a bonus)

- Fast turnaround. Batch of 5 back within 24 hours

- Enough English to follow written notes and understand what a line is doing

- Reliable daily availability, Monday to Friday minimum



NICE TO HAVE



- You've edited for TikTok Shop, affiliate or DR/UGC content specifically

- You understand hook, problem, product, CTA structure and can spot when a cut kills the pacing



DETAILS



- Part time to start, roughly 20 to 25 hours a week, growing to full time if it goes well

- Long term, ongoing. I'm hiring one person, not a rotation

- You work your own hours. I'm US Mountain time and I'd rather you edit overnight my time so I wake up to finished drafts

- Weekly pay



HOW TO APPLY



1. Put the word SCROLL in your subject line so I know you read this

2. Send 2 to 3 links to short-form vertical videos you personally edited

3. In one or two sentences, tell me what you'd change about the first 3 seconds of one of them, and why

4. Tell me your hours available and your rate



PAID TEST: shortlisted applicants get one of my real raw clips to cut, and I pay for it. That's how I d
, not the portfolio.

title: QA Engineer / SDET - AI-Augmented Testing
description:
About the role

RxPost is a ~15-person health-tech B2B platform running a serverless-first AWS stack (Lambda, API

Gateway, RDS, Amplify, Cognito). We're looking for a QA Engineer / SDET who writes test code, owns test

infrastructure, and is fluent in using AI tooling to author and maintain tests - as well as testing

AI-powered features themselves. You'll be the person who turns "we keep shipping regressions" into a

durable, automated safety net.

This is a hands-on, code-writing role. You'll work directly with a small engineering team and own QA

strategy end-to-end.



What you'll do

• Design and maintain end-to-end and regression test suites in Playwright (our current framework),

including using codegen and AI-assisted authoring to accelerate coverage.

• Use AI tooling (LLM-based test generation, self-healing selectors, AI code assistants) to reduce the cost

of writing and maintaining tests - with judgment about where AI helps and where it introduces

flakiness.

• Test LLM- and MCP-powered product features: build evaluation harnesses, define quality bars for

non-deterministic outputs, and design guardrail/regression checks for natural-language and

agent-driven workflows.

• Attack our three standing testing gaps: mock drift, untested Lambda infrastructure, and recurring

regressions that ship without accompanying tests.

• Build post-deploy smoke tests and contract tests against our integration layer (HubSpot, Dwolla,

Intercom, PostHog, Slack).

• Partner with engineering to enforce a Definition of Done that requires tests, and embed QA into the

sprint cadence rather than bolting it on at the end.



Must-have

• Strong JavaScript/TypeScript; you write and maintain test code, not just test plans.

• Production experience with Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent modern E2E frameworks.

• Hands-on experience using AI tools in a real testing workflow (test generation, maintenance, or triage).

• Experience testing non-deterministic / AI-powered systems, or a clear, credible approach to how you'd

do it.

• Comfort in AWS serverless environments (Lambda, API Gateway) and testing distributed integrations.

• Ability to own strategy independently in a small team.



Nice-to-have

• Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks or building eval/guardrail systems.

• MCP or agent-based tooling familiarity.

• Prior QA-in-a-startup experience where you built the function from scratch.

• Health-tech, fintech, or regulated-industry background.



Why this role

You'll own QA at a company that treats testing as an engineering problem, not a checkbox - with real

autonomy, a modern stack, and a mandate to bring AI into the workflow deliberately.

We use PagePilot to generate product pages. Your role is to further optimize these pages, make them more professional, and improve them for maximum conversion.

Responsibilities

Optimize Shopify product pages for higher conversion rates.

Create and improve product images and creatives using Higgsfield AI (paid access provided).

Think along about CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) and suggest improvements.

Ensure a professional and consistent look across the store.



Requirements

Proven experience with Shopify.

Experience optimizing product pages.

Strong understanding of CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization).

Experience with Shopify apps and product bundling.

Strong sense of design and product presentation.

Ability to work independently and take initiative.

Good command of English.

Basic knowledge of Dutch is a plus, but not required. Product pages are written in Dutch, but AI/translation tools may be used to understand and optimize them.



What we offer

Long-term collaboration.

Flexible working hours.

Weekly payments.

Hourly-based compensation.

Access to paid tools such as Higgsfield AI.

A growing e-commerce business with continuous work.



Application

Links to 2–3 Shopify product pages you have personally optimized.

A short explanation of what improvements you made and why.

Your hourly rate.

Your weekly availability.

How to Apply

This is NOT a passive sales role. You are expected to own your pipeline, follow up relentlessly, search and close deals.

The Role

Once a property owner becomes a client, you remain their primary point of contact and act as a product owner for their listings and cooperation. You ensure expectations are aligned, services are understood, and opportunities are maximised.



Your success is measured by signed clients, retained partnerships, and revenue, not by the number of calls made.



--------------------------

title: Finance & P&L Specialist  Dropshipping e-commmerce(Part-Time)
description:
We run a portfolio of e-commerce stores across Europe, the UK, the US. We move fast, we scale hard, and our numbers need to keep up. This role sits at the centre of that.



What this role actually is

We're not looking for someone to type numbers into cells. We're looking for a finance person who takes ownership of our profitability picture and tells us things we don't already know.



Your daily work:



- Maintain and update our daily P&L sheet ad spend across Meta, pinterest and Google, cost of goods, subscriptions, fees, refunds.

- Collect and organise every invoice into our drive folder,  and make sure each one is correctly reflected in the P&L

- Track recurring subscriptions and flag anything we're paying for and not using

- Keep our COGS tracking accurate across multiple stores and currencies

- Send daily and update in slack regarding the P/L of the day before + Estimated profit on weekly basis.

- Send weekly report in slack regarding the P/L every monday



That part takes roughly an hour a day. But the reason we're hiring is what comes on top:



- Spot where margin is leaking before we do.

- Build better systems and processes so this work gets faster and more reliable over time

- Be very experienced with claude to build certain tools and dashboards that can give us better insights in the whole business



We do not want to micromanage this. If we have to tell you what to look at, it isn't working.



What you need to have

Solid finance or bookkeeping background you understand P&L structure, margin, and what actually drives profitability in a business

Advanced Google Sheets skills. Our COGS tracking is big and complex. You should be comfortable with nested formulas, lookups, ARRAYFORMULA, QUERY, and building things that don't break

Excellent experience using Claude (Anthropic's AI). We use it throughout the business and you'll be expected to use it to work faster.

Strong English, written and spoken

Genuine ownership mentality. You ask questions, you flag problems, you don't wait to be told



Nice to have



E-commerce or dropshipping finance experience

Experience with Shopify, Meta Ads Manager, or Google Ads reporting

Any automation or scripting experience (Apps Script, Zapier, Make)



Where this goes



This starts as a focused daily finance role. For the right person it grows into a broader process and systems optimisation position building automations, improving how the whole operation runs, and working directly with AI tooling across departments. If you're good, there's a lot more here than an hour a day.



Details



Part-time, approximately 1 hour per day 7 days a week

Long-term position — we're looking for someone who stays



Ik zou dit als eigen sectie plaatsen tussen "Nice to have" en "Where this goes" — dan valt het op in plaats van weg te zakken in een bullet.



Bonus: serious Claude expertise



This is where it gets interesting for us. Beyond the finance work, we want someone who is genuinely expert with Claude not "I've used ChatGPT a few times," but someone who builds with it.



If you can do these things, tell us, because it changes the role and the pay massively:

Build dashboards and internal tools with Claude reporting views, trackers, anything that turns scattered data into something we can act on

Design and build agents that handle recurring work without a human in the loop

Apply Claude across departments, not just finance: customer service workflows, COGS analysis, supplier communication, listing quality, dispute handling

Look at how a department currently works and rebuild the process around what Claude can actually do — rather than bolting AI onto a broken system



We already use Claude throughout the business and we're pushing it further. If you're the person who sees a manual process and immediately knows how to automate it, this role can become a lot bigger than a daily P&L update.



How to apply



Start your letter with FINANCE



Send your application including:



A short description of the most complex spreadsheet you've built and what it did

One example of a time you spotted a financial problem before anyone asked you to look

How you currently use Claude or other AI tools in your work



Applications that ignore these three questions won't be reviewed.

title: Meta Ads Media Buyer
description:
SIZZ the brand is a fast growing DTC fashion brand focused on women 18-28, expanding within the European market.



We’re looking for an experienced Meta Ads Media Buyer who can take ownership of campaign management, optimization, and scaling as we expand across Europe.



This is not a junior execution role. We’re looking for someone who has managed meaningful budgets, understands how to scale DTC brands across multiple markets, and knows how to turn performance data into clear decisions.



What you'll own:

- Manage and scale Meta Ads campaigns across multiple European markets

- Own day-to-day campaign setup, budget allocation, and optimization

- Identify opportunities to scale winning campaigns while maintaining efficiency

- Analyze account performance and turn data into actionable decisions

- Monitor and report on key performance metrics

- Identify performance differences between countries and adapt accordingly

- Maintain strong account health while operating at significant spend levels

- Proven experience managing €100K+ in Meta ad spend per month

- Strong experience scaling DTC / e-commerce brands

- Fashion experience is a major plus

- Deep understanding of Meta Ads Manager, attribution, campaign structure, and optimization

- Experience managing and scaling campaigns across multiple countries

- Strong analytical skills and confidence making decisions based on performance data

- Comfortable working with significant budgets and moving quickly

- Proactive and able to operate independently

- Strong understanding of performance metrics such as ROAS, MER, CAC, CPA, and contribution margin

Why this role is interesting:



You’ll be joining at a key point in our growth.



We already have a strong foundation in the Netherlands and are now expanding aggressively across Germany, Austria and the Nordics.



You’ll have the opportunity to directly influence how we scale Meta across these markets, work with significant advertising budgets, and help build the paid acquisition engine behind the next stage of the brand’s growth.



We move fast, test constantly, and care about one thing above all: profitable growth.



To apply, please sent us:

- A short introduction about yourself and your Meta Ads experience

- Your experience with DTC / e-commerce brands

- Your experience with fashion brands, if applicable

- The largest monthly Meta Ads budget you’ve personally managed

- Concrete examples of results you’ve achieved

- Markets you have experience advertising in

- Your current availability

- Your preferred contractor rate



Please only apply if you have personally managed at least €100K/month in Meta ad spend for a single brand.

title: Marketing Coordinator (Growth Track to Marketing Lead)
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines) – Preference will be given to applicants based in or near General Santos City, as many of our tea
mbers are located there and we regularly organize team gatherings and activities.



Working Hours: Monday to Friday | 09:00 – 18:00 (Central European Time - CEST)



Employment Type: Full-time



____



About Us



We are an international organization operating in the real estate industry.



Rather than offering all of our services under a single name, we operate through several specialized brands. Each brand focuses on a specific service or target audience, making it clear to our customers who they are working with.



While our customers know us through different brands, behind the scenes we are one organization with one team. We collaborate across departments, share knowledge, support one another, and work towards the same goals.



Our organization provides services to property owners, landlords, tenants, and international students. Our activities include property management, student housing, relocation services, rental support, facility-related services, and other real estate-related solutions.



As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a motivated Marketing Coordinator who enjoys creating structure, coordinating projects, and helping our brands reach their full potential.



____



About the Role



This is not a traditional marketing position.



We’re not looking for someone who only manages social media or creates content.



We’re looking for someone who can oversee the bigger picture, understand the needs of our different brands, coordinate marketing activities, and ensure every initiative contributes to measurable business growth.



You’ll coordinate the work of our marketing specialists, maintain an overview of all ongoing projects, monitor quality, and ensure deadlines are met.



Our Marketing Department already includes specialists in areas such as Graphic Design and Analytics & Reporting. You’ll work closely with them to ensure projects move forward efficiently and deliver measurable results.



When necessary, you’re free to outsource work such as website updates, graphic design, content creation, or other marketing-related tasks. While you’re encouraged to make use of external expertise when appropriate, you’re also responsible for reviewing all deliverables and ensuring they meet our quality standards before publication.



You’ll report directly to the CEO and work closely with every department within the organization.



____



Your Responsibilities



Marketing Coordination



* Coordinate marketing activities across all brands.

* Develop marketing plans together with the CEO.

* Maintain an overview of all ongoing marketing projects.

* Set priorities and monitor deadlines.

* Ensure projects are completed on time and meet our quality standards.



Brand Development



* Strengthen the visibility and positioning of our brands.

* Ensure consistent branding and communication.

* Increase brand awareness in both existing and new markets.



Lead Generation



* Develop initiatives that generate qualified leads.

* Work closely with the Sales Department to improve lead conversion.

* Identify opportunities to increase customer acquisition.

* Continuously improve the customer journey from first contact through conversion.



Team Coordination



Coordinate and oversee the work of our marketing specialists, including:



* Graphic Design

* Analytics & Reporting

* Content Creation

* Digital Marketing

* External freelancers and agencies



You’ll coordinate planning, monitor progress, review completed work, and ensure all deliverables meet our standards before publication.



Project Coordination



Coordinate projects including:



* Website improvements

* Landing pages

* Content creation

* Marketing campaigns

* Graphic design

* SEO

*
 marketing

* Promotional campaigns

* Marketing automation



Cross-Department Collaboration



You’ll work closely with:



* Sales

* Operations

* Finance

* Human Resources

* Development

* Customer Success



Understanding the objectives of each department is essential to ensuring marketing supports the organization as a whole.



Innovation



We believe innovation drives growth.



We actively encourage the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to improve productivity, creativity, research, and efficiency. AI should always be used as a professional tool, while ensuring that the final output remains natural, authentic, and aligned with the quality of our brands.



If you believe new software, training, tools, or external expertise would improve the Marketing Department, we encourage you to present your ideas. We value initiative and are always open to investing in improvements that create long-term value.



Process Improvement



You’ll help us continue building a professional and scalable Marketing Department by:



* Improving internal marketing workflows.

* Developing and maintaining Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

* Creating more structure and consistency.

* Improving collaboration between departments.

* Working together with our Development Department on marketing technology and automation.



____



What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who:



* Takes ownership and responsibility.

* Enjoys coordinating people and projects.

* Thinks strategically while remaining practical.

* Has strong organizational and planning skills.

* Can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

* Has a commercial mindset.

* Communicates confidently with different departments.

* Enjoys improving processes.

* Is proactive and solution-oriented.

* Continuously looks for ways to improve both themselves and the organization.



Experience coordinating marketing activities is an advantage, but we value attitude, initiative, and the ability to organize and lead projects just as highly.



____



What We Offer



A Position That Makes a Difference



Your work will have a direct impact on the growth of our brands and the continued development of our organization.



Freedom to Improve



We encourage initiative. If you identify opportunities to improve our websites, campaigns, workflows, automation, AI usage, or internal processes, we’ll give your ideas serious consideration.



One Team



Although our customers know us through different brands, internally we operate as one organization. You’ll work closely with colleagues across Sales, Operations, Finance, Human Resources, Development, Customer Success, and Management.



A Connected Remote Team



We work remotely, but we believe strong teams are built through collaboration and personal connections.



Many of our colleagues are based in General Santos City, and we regularly organize team gatherings and activities. While participation is never mandatory, we encourage everyone to join whenever possible.



Career Growth



This position has been designed as a growth opportunity. As your responsibilities increase and your results become measurable, your role, salary, and career opportunities will grow alongside the organization.



____



Salary Progression



We believe responsibility, initiative, measurable performance, and business results should be rewarded. Rather than offering a fixed salary from day one, we’ve created a structured growth path that recognizes both professional development and measurable business impact.



Phase 1 – Business Familiarization & Onboarding (Month 1)



Salary: PHP 20,000 per month



This first month serves as a mutual evaluation period.



You’ll become familiar with our organization, brands, services, systems, and ways of working, while we evaluate whether we’re the right long-term fit for one another.



During this phase you will:



* Learn about our brands and services.

* Become familiar with our systems and workflows.

* Meet the different departments.

* Review our current marketing activities.

* Identify opportunities for improvement.



Following a successful evaluation, you’ll progress to Phase 2.



____



Phase 2 – Strategy Development & Initial Execution



Salary: PHP 30,000 per month



During this phase you will:



* Develop and present your proposed marketing strategy.

* Begin implementing approved initiatives.

* Coordinate internal specialists and external suppliers.

* Improve existing marketing activities.

* Introduce additional structure, planning, and organization within the Marketing Department.



Progression to Phase 3 is based on the successful implementation of the agreed strategy and a positive performance evaluation.



____



Phase 3 – Marketing Performance & Measurable Growth



Salary: PHP 42,000 per month



Progression to this phase is based on demonstrating measurable marketing success.



Examples include:



* Increased website traffic.

* Improved search engine rankings.

* Growth in social media engagement.

* Increased brand awareness.

* Higher engagement across marketing channels.

* Growth in qualified website enquiries.

* Improved
 marketing performance.

* Successful execution of marketing campaigns.

* Achievement of agreed marketing KPIs.



Progression to Phase 4 is not automatic and requires measurable commercial results.



____



Phase 4 – Commercial Performance & Business Growth



Salary: PHP 53,000 per month



This phase is reserved for candidates who consistently demonstrate that their marketing initiatives create measurable commercial value.



In addition to maintaining the marketing performance achieved in Phase 3, progression to this phase requires clear evidence that marketing activities have generated qualified leads that are successfully converted into paying customers.



Examples include:



* Marketing-generated leads converted into customers.

* Sustainable growth in customer acquisition.

* Demonstrable contribution to company revenue.

* Successful collaboration with the Sales Department resulting in increased conversions.

* Marketing initiatives that consistently deliver long-term commercial value.



As the organization continues to grow, additional salary increases, performance bonuses, and further career opportunities will be available for individuals who consistently contribute to our long-term success.



____



Ready to Apply?



If you’re looking for a position where your ideas matter, your work creates measurable impact, and your career can grow alongside an ambitious international organization, we’d love to hear from you.



Please include the following with your application:



* Your CV or resume.

* A short introduction about yourself.

* Examples of marketing projects or campaigns you’ve coordinated.

* Any measurable results you’ve achieved, such as website growth, SEO improvements, increased engagement, lead generation, or customer acquisition.

* A brief explanation of why you’re interested in joining our team.



We look forward to meeting you.

Roughly half of your time will be spent on SDS management operations — maintaining our Safety Data Sheet database and supporting manufacturer outreach. The other half will focus on customer support and growth for our ISDSS platform, handling user queries through live chat,

title: FPA and M&A Associate
description:
About Us:

Profitability Partners is a distinguished fractional CFO business based in Tampa, Florida, specializing in delivering financial expertise to small and medium-sized home services businesses looking to exit. We are on the lookout for an experienced individual with a comprehensive background in M&A, FP&A and accounting. This remote, full-time opportunity is ideal for an overseas professional eager to take on a central role in our expansion, with opportunity to grow within the business.



Key Responsibilities:



Financial Modelling

• Build and construct three-statement, driver-based models, budgets, and 13-week cash flow forecasts.

• Run scenario/sensitivity analyses for pricing, hiring, capex, and capital allocation.

• Business Valuation Familiarity



Lead Exit-Readiness & M&A Support

• Prepare diligence-ready financials: EBITDA bridges, normalization adjustments, and working capital analyses.

• Assemble and maintain data rooms; create CIM/board-ready exhibits and KPI schedules.



Own Monthly Reporting & Board Materials

• Produce detailed financial reporting of PNL, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow Statement.

• Build concise “board style” decks in PowerPoint with trends, bridges, and forward views.

• Deliver flash reports for founders and investors.



Instrument & Analyze KPIs

• Define the metric architecture (definitions, calculations, owners, cadence).

• Build Excel-based dashboards for unit economics, marketing spend, etc

• Translate operational data into financial impact.



Please Note: M&A experience (FDD/Transaction advisory, investment banking or other M&A experience is required). We will also consider those with FP&A experience.



Book keeping and full cycle accounting experience as well as Quickbooks familiarity is a strong plus.



This role will be full time and the expectation is that the role is your primary focus with no contracting/other roles done on the side.

Please do not apply if this profile does not suite your experience or desired work arrangement.



Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; Master’s degree or MBA preferred.

CPA certification is required.

At least 5 years of M&A and FP&A related experience

Audit experience, bookkeeping, full cycle accounting and Quickbooks experience is also preferred

Experience with accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, NetSuite, Wave).

Experience as an FP&A analyst or manager and familiarity working with financial models and forward-looking projections

C1 level or higher proficiency in English.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

A strong sense of ethics, confidentiality, and professionalism.

Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines.
